jobs.title: JJSE Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Mission Graduates** is a nonprofit organization that increases the number of K-12 students in San Francisco's Mission District who are prepared for and complete a college education. We work towards fulfilling our mission through a wide range of afterschool support services that serve over 4,800 children, youth, and families each year. Our vision is to transform the culture of our neighborhood so that college becomes the expectation for Mission families, rather than the exception.

**Program Summary:** Mission Graduates has been providing quality afterschool programming for its entire 50-year history. The organization is partnering with June Jordan School of Equity (JJSE) to develop and implement a quality afterschool program that blends extracurricular activities and builds a college-going culture on campus. Youth who participate in the program develop a sense of self-confidence in their ability to learn, to speak their voice, and contribute to their community. The program infuses college messaging throughout its curriculum to ensure both youth and parents develop or strengthen expectations for entering college.

  

**Key Responsibilities & Primary Duties**

### **Program Management & Evaluation (25%)**

Assist in the maintenance of all program records, particularly maintenance of attendance.  
Assist the Director in developing and managing the annual program budget.  
Maintain knowledge of ExCEL policies and procedures.  
Assist in program evaluation and the utilization of evaluation findings in program development to ensure positive outcomes.  
Assist in the preparation of funding proposals and reports to funders.

### **Program Quality, Support, & Delivery (50%)**

* Work with program staff to deliver quality afterschool programming, including supervision of at least three clubs or programs.

  + Lead the JJSE leadership student group, meeting weekly. Create meeting agendas, lead activities, and support students in running school-wide events.
  + Manage the academic tutoring program and referral process.
* Uphold all school-site policies for safety, supervision, mandated reporting, and risk management.

* Assist in the preparation of internal marketing materials to be disseminated to students, parents, and the JJSE community.
* Collaborate closely with community stakeholders including parents and caregivers, community-based organizations, and SFUSD.
* Assist the JJSE Director in developing parent engagement activities and maintaining positive parent relations with current JJSE families.
* Assist and lead summer programming in academics, enrichment, and/or recreation.

### **Supervise Consultants & Volunteers (10%)**

* In collaboration with other MG team members, oversee recruitment, training, and supervision of volunteers and program consultants.
* Assist/Support the SFUSD teachers and staff who are given stipends to implement Extended Day clubs and activities.

### **Family Recruitment and Outreach (15%)**

* Engaging with families to facilitate two-way communication and information sharing, highlighting school and program activities at JJSE.
* Attend high school tabling events at middle schools and positively represent JJSE to prospective families.
* Reach out to prospective high school families in the neighborhood and middle schools to share JJSE programs and schedule school tours.

### **Required Qualifications**

* 1-2 years of proven experience and ability in working in education and/or youth programs.
* Demonstrated knowledge of and experience with best practices in youth development program planning, curriculum development, teaching methods, and evaluation.
* Familiarity with college access challenges that are specific to first-generation college students.
* Familiarity and experience working with undocumented youth.
* Bilingual Spanish/English fluency preferred.
* BA or BS required.
* Current CPR certification (or attained within 2 months of employment).
* TB test clearance is required before hiring.
* Experience working in communities of color with low-income populations.
* Some weekends and evenings required

**Benefits Package:** Includes fully paid Medical, Dental, and Vision for the employee; access to Pre-Tax Commuter Benefits; and access to a 403(b) account at the time of hire. We also offer an employer contribution for eligible staff\* (eligibility to be explained at the time of hire). In addition, we offer 13 paid holidays per year, 8 personal hours per year, and PTO accrual (vacation and sick).

*Mission Graduates Is an Equal Opportunity Employer*

*Mission Graduates provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants in all of our employment practices, including selection, hiring, promotion, transfer, termination, leaves of absence, training, and compensation, without regard to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, uniformed service member/veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, medical condition or disability, in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**Program Coordinator, Physical AI Program, R&D Division**

**Company:** Hitachi America Ltd.

**Division:** R&D Division

**Location:** Santa Clara, California (on-site)

**Status:** Full Time, limited-term (6 months, with possibility of extension)

**The Company**

**About Hitachi America, Ltd.**

Hitachi America, Ltd. is the regional headquarters for Hitachi Group companies in the Americas, overseeing the U.S., Canada, and Latin America markets. Headquartered in Santa Clara, California, Hitachi Americas has been deeply committed to its Social Innovation Business since its establishment in 1959, addressing society's most pressing challenges through innovative solutions. Leveraging its expertise and resources, Hitachi Americas and its subsidiary companies operate across diverse sectors, including transportation, energy, mobility, industrial manufacturing, healthcare, digital engineering, data analytics and others. Driven by Digital, Green, and Innovation, Hitachi Americas remains at the forefront of pioneering solutions that shape the future. For further details, please visit https://www.hitachi.us/ .

Through its Social Innovation Business (SIB) that brings together IT, OT (Operational Technology) and products, Hitachi contributes to a harmonized society where the environment, wellbeing, and economic growth are in balance. Hitachi operates globally in four sectors – Digital Systems & Services, Energy, Mobility, and Connective Industries – and the Strategic SIB Business Unit for new growth businesses. With Lumada at its core, Hitachi generates value from integrating data, technology and domain knowledge to solve customer and social challenges.

**Summary**

Hitachi America's R&D Division in Santa Clara is Hitachi's research arm in North America. Its labs work with Hitachi's businesses in rail, energy, industry and digital infrastructure, and with research counterparts in Japan, to take new technology from the lab into use. One of its largest current efforts is a multi-site Physical AI program with Hitachi businesses and partners in the Americas, bringing robots and AI systems into the inspection and operation of industrial sites.

  

The Program Coordinator sits in the division's Program Management Office and is the coordinator for this program. The job is to keep its many parties moving together: the division's labs, Hitachi's research centers in Japan and other regions, the Hitachi businesses that host the sites, and outside partners such as technology providers, universities and startups. The role owns the program plan, meeting schedule, action tracking, stakeholder records and reporting. It suits someone who has run a program with many stakeholders and wants to learn how industrial AI is put to work.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Maintain the program plan and calendar across sites, labs and partners. Prepare and run program meetings and workshops, record the decisions, and make sure the actions get done.
* Keep track of what the program has promised to each business, partner and research counterpart, with dates, deliverables and reporting, and tell the program's leadership early when something is slipping.
* Be the first contact for program members and outside parties on schedules, information and logistics. Bring new members from the labs, businesses and partners up to speed, and organize site visits and travel.
* Coordinate with Hitachi's research centers in Japan and other regions so that work on the program stays aligned across time zones, and keep a shared record of who is doing what.
* Follow the Program Management Office's processes for external engagements, agreements and contracts, working with Legal and the business units as needed.
Write status reports and briefing notes for R&D management, business sponsors and counterparts in Japan, with input from the technical leads, and make sure that what goes to partners meets export control, intellectual property and confidentiality rules.  

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience, and three or more years coordinating a program with many stakeholders.
* A record of keeping a program on schedule when the people involved sit in several organizations and none of them report to the coordinator.
* Clear writing, and the ability to turn a technical discussion into a short summary that an executive or a partner can act on.
* Careful with detail. Plans, trackers and records stay accurate and current.
* Interest in robotics, AI and industrial technology. A technical background helps but is not required; willingness to learn Hitachi's businesses is essential.
* Comfortable working across organizations, cultures and time zones, including with colleagues in Japan. Experience in an international organization is a plus.
Fluent with AI tools in everyday work, such as drafting and summarizing documents, preparing meeting notes and keeping plans and trackers current, and keen to find where they can take over routine coordination.  

**Our Values**

We are proud to say we are an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to any factor that doesn’t impact your ability to do the job, including race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Our mission at Ansa Biotechnologies is to revolutionize the way we make DNA. Compared to reading or editing life’s code, writing new code from scratch has remained one of the field’s most elusive challenges. We believe that the biggest challenges our world faces will be solved using biotechnology and that DNA synthesis is the fuel for that transformation. Our enzyme-based approach (published in Nature Biotechnology) promises to dramatically accelerate innovation in biological research and biotechnology, including therapeutics, diagnostics, biomanufacturing, and synthetic biology.

jobs.title: Clinical Case Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description:

**Clinical Case Manager**

**Transitional Age Youth Full Service Partnership (TAY FSP)**

**Adult Division**

**Agency Overview**

Felton Institute responds to the needs of our community by providing innovative, evidence-informed social services that transform lives. Our organization offers 60+ programs that address mental health, the unhoused, early care and education, those impacted by the justice system, transitional age youth, as well as aging adults. Our programs combine the latest scientific research with cultural sensitivity and a deep commitment to supporting and reflecting the communities we serve. Felton offers a dynamic, challenging, and supportive work environment where we encourage the use of professional development, that staff can utilize throughout their career.

**Program Description**

Serving young adults living with serious mental illness, the TAY FSP program provides an extensive array of recovery-oriented, age-appropriate services and supports, including linkage to housing, basic needs, physical health care, benefits assistance, and employment services, and integrated mental health and substance abuse treatment services. The program follows an assertive community treatment model, providing medication management, individual and group therapy, individual and group rehabilitation, crisis intervention, and case management both in the office and in the community. The program consists of a multi-disciplinary team of a psychiatrist(s), nurse practitioner(s), registered nurse(s), a program director, clinical case managers, case managers, a client support specialist, and an administrative manager. Clinicians are expected to provide services to clients both in the office and in the field.

**Job Description**

The Clinical Case Manager (CCM) meets with and evaluates the needs of clients and develops a treatment plan in collaboration with the client. The Clinical Case Manager provides specialized mental health services, including therapy, rehabilitative skills training, crisis intervention, and case management. The Clinical Case Manager provides a safe and supportive environment for the client and their support system and adheres to laws regarding confidentiality and mandated reporting. Services are provided both in the field (hospital, client’s home, courthouse, doctor’s office, etc.) and in the office. The Clinical Case Manager must maintain accurate detailed records in our electronic health record system. The caseload for each CCM is at least 17 clients.

**Specific Responsibilities**

* Provide individual and group therapy, individual and group rehabilitative skills training, case management, and crisis intervention services to our clients.
* Link clients to basic needs, including income, housing, job training, insurance, and/or nutrition, among other resources.
* Assist clients in creating and maintaining stability in the community by offering at least weekly appointments.
* Collaborate with community partners in housing, finance, basic needs, and medical services.
* Provide independent living skills education to clients in the office and in their home.
* Responsible for an average of 60-66 hours of direct services per month.
* Maintain timely documentation of services provided that meet Medi-Cal standards.
* Provide officer-of-the-day responsibilities to TAY and Adult Mental Health Program clients.
* Maintains responsibility for the 24/7 crisis response phone during assigned coverage periods (usually every other month for a 2-week period), ensuring accessibility, timely response, and appropriate follow-up to all incoming crisis calls via phone. In-person response to calls outside of work hours (9am-5pm) is not required.

**Minimum Requirements and Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Social Work, MFT, or related field of study required.
* Must be, or have the potential to be, registered with California BBS and have an active associates number.
* Experience providing mental health services and/or case management to those living with a severe mental illness and/or substance use preferred.
* Comprehensive knowledge of mental health and substance abuse counseling, assessment, and crisis intervention skills.
* Willingness to work from a strength-based, harm reduction, client-centered model with an emphasis on evidence-based practices.
* Ability to work cooperatively on a multi-disciplinary team, and to work with people of various ethnic and cultural backgrounds.
* Strong organizational, communication, documentation, time management, and interpersonal skills.

**Additional Information:**

Reports to: Program Director

Job Type: Full Time

Work Schedule: Onsite and in the community Mon-Fri 9am-5pm

FLSA Status: Exempt

Salary Range: $100,000 - $110,000 Annually (DOE)

Benefits (subject to election and eligibility): Fully-Paid Medical and Dental Plans; Health Reimbursement Card, Paid Time Off (personal, vacation, and sick time), 403B with company match.

*This position is union-represented by SEIU Local 1021 and is subject to the applicable collective bargaining agreement.*

**Applying Instruction:**

Candidates should apply for the position at our career page “careers.felton.org” OR directly email resumes to “jobs@felton.org”.

**IMP NOTE: Job responsibilities are subject to change according to program requirements.**

jobs.title: Program Manager for the Employee Productivity Program
jobs.description:
Your Team Responsibilities:

Workforce Produtivity is responsible for advancing the CEO’s goal of increasing employee productivity and supporting the broader objective of keeping run-the-business costs flat and reducing them over time. We identify and coordinate opportunities to help employees work more effectively, improve their experience, and realize measurable value from technology and AI.

We partner across Workforce Productivity & Technology, the WPT AI Program team, AI Champions, the AI Center of Excellence, office heads, Learning & Development, Internal Communications, and Corporate Services. Together, we engage employees, surface needs and ideas, develop and deliver productivity initiatives, and support adoption of tools and improved ways of working.

We also establish how progress will be measured and reported, including relevant indicators of productivity, technology adoption, and employee experience. Our work includes organizing or supporting regular employee events and learning opportunities that build awareness and help employees apply practical ways to improve their work.

Your Key Ressponsibilities:

* Lead the planning and coordination of the Workforce Productivity program, translating the CEO’s productivity goal into a coordinated portfolio of initiatives and measurable outcomes.
* Identify, assess, and prioritize opportunities to improve how employees work, enhance employee experience, and support flat or declining run-the-business costs over time.
* Build strong working relationships across the organization, including AI Champions, the AI Center of Excellence, office heads, Learning & Development, Internal Communications, Corporate Services, and the WPT AI Program team.
* Engage employees to understand their needs, gather feedback, surface opportunities, and encourage participation in productivity initiatives.
* Design and facilitate workshops that help employees develop practical ideas, solutions, and strategies to improve productivity and workplace experience.
* Coordinate communication, learning, and engagement activities, including at least four employee events or learning opportunities per month that the program sponsors, organizes, or supports.
* Partner with the WPT AI Program team to improve employee awareness, adoption, and experience of AI solutions and other productivity technologies.
* Define program success measures and establish processes to track, evaluate, and report progress and outcomes.
* Manage program workstreams, milestones, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder updates to support delivery of agreed priorities.
* Lead and develop at least one direct report responsible for employee experience, engagement, and improving interactions with WPT AI solutions.
* Use AI and other appropriate tools to streamline program administration and routine work, freeing time for employee engagement, collaboration, and high-impact initiatives.

Your skills and experience that will help you excel:

### **Skills and Expertise Required**

* **Program leadership:** At least 10 years of program management experience, including coordinating complex, cross-functional initiatives and delivering against agreed outcomes.
* **Employee engagement and experience:** Demonstrated experience designing or delivering employee engagement programs and improving the employee experience in a workplace setting.
* **Workshop facilitation:** Proven ability to plan and facilitate workshops that engage employees, surface opportunities, and develop practical strategies.
* **Communication:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messages to different audiences and build clear, compelling narratives.
* **Stakeholder management:** Strong relationship-building and influencing skills across teams with different priorities, roles, and levels of seniority.
* **Execution and organization:** Ability to manage multiple workstreams, priorities, milestones, and dependencies while maintaining focus on outcomes.
* **Motivation and collaboration:** Ability to bring people together, encourage participation, and motivate others to deliver shared goals.
* **Measurement and reporting:** Ability to define meaningful success measures, track progress, interpret feedback and results, and communicate outcomes.
* **AI-enabled productivity:** Practical ability to use AI tools to streamline routine work and improve personal productivity, with sound judgment about where human review is needed.

jobs.title: Customer Experience Operations Manager, Business Unit
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

Our Customer Experience team owns the full post-sales lifecycle for one of Rippling’s largest business units, from onboarding and implementation to escalations and renewals—we’re united by a passion for customers and continuous improvement, and we’re committed to personal and professional growth.

In this role, you're expected to be a builder: you’ll design and run the post-sales operating model for the business unit from the ground up. Our model runs on a lean, task-based system where every motion is defined, measured, and repeatable. You’ll define what success looks like, set the KPIs, map and build the workflows, write the playbooks, and keep refining the machine as the business grows.

You will also bridge data and day-to-day execution: building multi-factor health scores, engineering automated risk interventions, refining lifecycle touch points across the whole Product Experience to maximize retention outcomes.

Last, you’ll be the technical architect of the systems behind it and be the main business partner to CX leadership. You’ll find the truth in the data, turn it into action, and own the outcome.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Build the post-sales operating model for the business unit: define success at each lifecycle stage, set the KPIs, and design how work flows across onboarding, implementation, customer success, escalations, and renewals.
* Own the architecture, data integrity, and configuration of our CX systems. Partner cross-functionally on integrations across CRM, billing, support, and product analytics.
* Analyze intervention outcomes to understand why accounts churn or save, and use what you learn to refine playbooks and train the team on save and de-escalation strategies.
* Establish automated early warning systems that detect leading indicators of churn well before renewal windows open.
* Develop proactive intervention playbooks mapped to specific risk triggers (e.g., missed payments, steep drops in platform activity, repeated support escalations).
* Own the customer sentiment program (NPS, CSAT): build and administer lifecycle-triggered surveys, analyze trends across customer segments, and run a closed-loop detractor playbook.
* Prepare and run weekly business reviews, and deliver weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting on gross and net retention, save rates, health score trends, and operational capacity.
* Manage and mentor a team of Retention Specialists through regular 1:1s, performance coaching, and workflow reviews. Set the SOPs, turnaround targets, and escalation protocols they work from.
* Partner with Product, Sales, and Support to surface upstream product frictions, onboarding bottlenecks, or misaligned customer expectations that contribute to churn.

**Who you are**
---------------

* **A builder.** You want to build the right system or workflow rather than inherit it; you’re comfortable in ambiguity, and you’ve done that before.
* **An owner.** When you see a problem, you act with urgency and you proactively own it until it’s solved; you are effective as a cross-functional operator.
* **A truth seeker.** You go to the data and to the frontline, you challenge assumptions (including your own), and make decisions based on what’s actually happening.
* **Thorough.** You sweat the details in workflows, data, and documentation, because a system is only as good as its details. You keep making the process better.

**What you will have**
----------------------

* 3–10+ years of experience in Customer Success Operations, RevOps, or CX Management within a B2B SaaS environment.
* 1+ years of direct people management or lead experience guiding retention, support, or customer success specialists.
* Experience building operations from the ground up in a high-growth environment.
* Track record of designing retention programs, renewal/save programs, and/or building automated risk-alert frameworks tied directly to measurable retention gains.
* Technical comfort owning and building systems; You're comfortable with SFDC, Jira, and/or CSP platforms (e.g. Vitally, Gainsight or ChurnZero), navigating API integrations, bi-directional syncing, and event-based tracking schemas.
* Strong data literacy; proficient in mapping SaaS metrics (NRR, GRR, Churn, LTV, Adoption velocity) and synthesizing raw analytics into operational priorities.
* Emerging AI Tooling Experience: you are comfortable integrating LLMs (e.g., Claude, OpenAI APIs) into CX tech stacks for automated ticket summarization, health score analysis, or retention playbook drafting.

**Additional Information**

* Lead end-to-end testing, UAT, rollout, training, and handoff to operational owners. Define success measures for traceability, data quality, manual effort, exception resolution, close readiness, and adoption.

* Experience partnering with software and data engineers to define requirements, resolve tradeoffs, test solutions, and deliver changes into production without direct authority.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Primary Purpose**  
  
The Operations Manager is responsible for enhancing the customer's shopping experience at a retail-oriented project by ensuring a clean, well maintained, and safe environment as well as asset preservation and enhancement. The Operations Manager will oversee operational functions, projects, construction, and contract / vendor services for Hillsdale Shopping Center.

**Principal Responsibilities**  
  
*The successful candidate's responsibilities will include, but not be limited to:*

* Oversee the daily operations of the shopping center including security, cleaning/ janitorial, landscaping, lighting, parking lot sweeping, etc. as needed to ensure compliance with service contracts and operational needs of the project.
* Manage relationships with third party contracted services providers. Interface with contractors and vendors.
* Create written specifications and secure bids for services in accordance with established bid process. Solicit bids, negotiate with vendors for goods and services, and hold vendors accountable for quality of work, billing accuracy and adherence to property policies & procedures.
* Research and evaluate best in class maintenance products and procedures.
* Conduct daily walk-throughs of the property to ensure physical assets are in best possible operating condition. Respond timely to any operational issues uncovered in property inspections and take action with appropriate vendor to correct issue as soon as possible.
* Lead and manage the CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) or work order system, coordinating with Local 39 engineering team to ensure work orders are tracked, prioritized, and completed in a timely manner.
* Ensure property safety systems are up to code, maintained and inspected.
* Manage property operating expenses within or below budget. Effectively manage negative financial variances to overcome or minimize loss within the property operating budget.
* Develop and implement a 5-year capital plan to operate, maintain and enhance the asset / property.
* Develop and oversee a preventative maintenance program on property equipment and record keeping / related logs.
* Manage (or co-manage along with Development and Construction departments) the work process for capital projects, construction, and tenant build-outs. Serve as the “boots on the ground” for monitoring and overseeing daily construction activity, review build-outs are completed to specifications, create punch-list items, and gather required documentation prior to project close-out and/or payment.
* Read and interpret engineering drawings, schematic diagrams, and build-out plans.
* Be familiar with general construction, sub-contractors, and project management.
* Ensure certificates of insurance are requested / received from all vendors working on the property.
* Maintain a safe environment through identification and elimination of any safety hazards to staff, tenants, and customers. This includes the administration of all training and regulatory programs (OSHA, ADA, EPA etc.).
* Ensure public safety, shopping center security, insurance protocols and effective risk management. Work with security and local officials to plan and oversee a fire safety program and coordinate onsite annual trainings with fire and police departments.
* Complete timely review, processing and approval of vendor invoices, to ensure accurate services were provided prior to payment.
* General knowledge of leases and / or ability to review in order to determine responsibility of operational issues.
* Oversee property utilities and implement an energy / utility plan to minimize costs while maintaining a comfortable and safe shopping experience.
* Assist in preparation and oversee operational budgets and ensure all costs associated with property operations are managed. Report on variances.
* Provide operations support as necessary for special events, marketing events and holidays.
* Assist the General Manager in the creation and planning of the Emergency Management Plan. Ensure all personnel are trained and ready to respond as outlined in the Emergency Management Plan.
* Oversee operational responsibilities in a crisis situation, ensuring the safety and security of customers, tenants, guest and assets. Help oversee any insurance claim and process.
* Responds to tenant operational issues. Resolves escalated customer / tenant complaints related to operations and maintenance.
* Establish strong relationships with service providers and key civic roles (Code Officials, Fire Safety, Police, Fire, etc.).

**Minimum Qualifications**

  

* Minimum 5 years of prior Operations, Facilities or Property Management experience.
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience.
* Working knowledge of property maintenance and operational functions.
* Working knowledge and past experience leading and managing a CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) at an asset to create and manage all work orders at a property. Experience with Cove a plus.
* Ability to read and understand blueprints, CAD drawings and other schematics.
* Ability to remain standing/walking 75% of the time.
* Customer service focused.
* Ability to be on call for emergencies.
* Self-motivated, team player with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Intermediate to advanced computer skills (email, excel, word, online systems, etc.).
* Valid driver's license.
* Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

**JOB OVERVIEW:**

The Operations Manager (OM) is responsible for the direct or indirect oversight and coordination of all operational functions in the Bay Area (San Jose and Oakland) grouping, resulting in a well-functioning, compliant operational environment. The Operations Manager serves as the primary liaison for HQ Regional Functional Leads including Supply Chain Advisor (SCA), Regional Safety & Security Director (RSSD), Regional IT Director (RITD) and Global Facilities Director (GFD). This position reports to the Executive Director and oversees the Operations staff in both offices. This position is based in either San Jose or Oakland, with regular weekly onsite presence within both offices.

**Major Responsibilities:**

**Safety & Security—S&S:**

* Oversee regional S&S matters.
* Responsible for the implementation and maintenance of all office S&S documentation.
* Organize all-staff S&S meetings at office or program site.
* Ensure that a minimum of one emergency evacuation is exercised at office or program site level per year and other appropriate trainings informed by Security Risk Assessment findings.
* Cascade HQ and/or office security warnings and advisories to staff, interns, and volunteers as needed.
* Report all S&S incidents involving covered persons in accordance with established protocols.
* Coordinate immediate incident management including filing police reports.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with other S&S actors or stakeholders, including but not limited to community organizations and partners, authorities, security and rescue services, and property owners.
* Assist in the development of office-specific S&S onboarding materials, ensuring the provision of S&S briefings to new staff and covered persons.

**Supply Chain—SC:**

* Serve as the region’s primary focal point for procurement, asset and inventory management, in-kind donations tracking and reporting, vehicle fleet management and transportation, and warehousing in accordance with established organizational and donor requirements.
* Lead the bidding process, including request for quotation process, request for proposal process, tender evaluation, and facilitating procurement committee functioning.
* Manage relationships with suppliers and vendors.
* Maintain up-to-date supplier and service provider records. Maintain asset register and inventory lists of purchased and donated items. Establish and manage inventory control for office supplies, stationery, and other consumables. In collaboration with the Finance Manager, ensure inventories reconcile with financial reports.
* Support program teams in meeting their match goals.
* Ensure policy compliance for the fleet of IRC-owned vehicles and oversee their maintenance and usage.
* Working with HQ Supply Chain to maintain IRC policy at all the times.
* Control and maintain the IRC policy through the PO system in Integra.

**Facilities Management:**

* Manage the region’s office and equipment leases, coordinate repairs and improvements with property managers, and lead the procurement of office equipment.
* Coordinate the allocation of workspaces and support related employee lifecycle needs such as building access.
* Support smooth functioning of office infrastructure including communications equipment and services.
* Assist with planning and coordinating office events and meetings.
* Responsible for coordinating on- and off-site storage needs.
* Maintain NorCal’s status with all counties related to annual property’s tax along with exemption status.

**Information Technology—IT:**

* Oversee grouping IT and communications infrastructure, hardware and software matters.
* Educate staff about IT support resources, including appropriate channels for incident reporting.
* Work with regional and HQ IT team to address any internet or telecommunications service disruptions, liaising with local internet and telecommunications service providers.
* Escalate any unresolved incidents or larger-scale IT projects (such as office moves or expansion) as needed.
* Ensure compliance with IT protocols, policies, and procedures including information security policy, IT procurement and asset management policy, acceptable use of IT resources policy, and new software procurement protocols.

**Other Duties**

* Provide mentorship and supervision to Operations staff, including leading team meetings, individual supervision and coaching, and conducting goal setting, and performance reviews.
* Approve Integra vendor creations and invoice journals.
* Coordinate with the Finance Director to manage administrative expenses and reports.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Key Working Relationships:**

* **Position reports to:** Executive Director
* **Position directly supervises:** Front Desk staff, Operations staff

**Job Requirements:**

* Undergraduate degree in business, non-profit management, public administration, or others related field preferred
* At least five years of related professional experience; preferably with refugee services and in a non-profit or social service environment
* Experience supervising staff preferred
* Demonstrated ability to work with deadlines and lead multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

US: $178000 - $258000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

------------

Join Intuit as a Staff Program Manager on the Customer Success team. This is a high-impact role for a builder and craftsperson: someone who can take a vision, design the blueprint, assemble the right team, and lead them from zero to fully functioning, high-performing execution.

You will be responsible for shaping strategy, architecting programs from the ground up, and organizing teams around the work so they can deliver with precision and speed. You will bring structure where there is ambiguity, create alignment across functions, and operationalize our most strategic and transformational programs that serve our global customer base.

This role requires not just strategic thinking, but a deep commitment to craft: ensuring that every process, meeting cadence, and deliverable is designed for maximum clarity, momentum, and results. You will work directly with senior leadership and executives on a regular basis, managing up and down effectively, presenting program updates and recommendations that inspire confidence, and securing buy-in and trust quickly across all levels of the organization.

**Responsibilities**

* Architect from the Ground Up: Design, structure, and launch multi-org programs from inception to execution, ensuring every piece of the work is owned, sequenced, and connected to our GBSG strategic objectives.
* Organize and Mobilize: Build the right team for the work, instill operational discipline, and establish clear roles, accountability, and workflows that keep everyone aligned and moving fast.
* Execute Flawlessly: Drive execution with precision, using metrics, principles, and risk mitigation strategies to ensure the work stays on track and delivers measurable business outcomes for our global customers.
* Strategic Storytelling and Influence: Tie GBSG business unit, portfolio, and program strategies together into a cohesive narrative. Use influence and data to drive alignment and buy-in at all levels.
* Partner with Senior Leadership: Engage regularly with executives to align on priorities, present progress and recommendations, and gain their trust and sponsorship quickly.
* Prioritize with Rigor: Identify the highest-impact initiatives, manage trade-offs, and escalate key decisions with clear recommendations and rationale.
* Communicate for Impact: Deliver crisp, relevant updates to diverse audiences: from front-line managers to senior executives, ensuring clarity on strategy, execution status, and next steps.
* Resolve and Adapt: Anticipate challenges, navigate competing interests, and adjust course quickly while keeping teams motivated and focused.

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience leading complex, cross-functional SaaS programs with a proven ability to build and scale new initiatives from scratch.
* Track record of starting in ambiguity and creating clarity: designing programs, teams, and processes that deliver high-quality outcomes fast.
* Strong operational craft: expertise in program design, governance models, decision frameworks, and execution tracking.
* Skilled at using data to facilitate tough conversations, align leaders, and communicate risks, outcomes, and recommendations with confidence.
* Demonstrated ability to manage up and down effectively: build trust, secure buy-in, and present regularly to senior leadership with impact.

* Highly effective communicator across multiple formats and audiences, capable of driving alignment and action through compelling narratives.

---------------

The Amazon Devices Beta (ADB) Team is your hall pass to play at work!! By playing with these products every day! We work with product and engineering teams to prepare new product launches, system software and app updates, and marketplace expansions. Our goal is to gather feedback and expose issues and bugs prior to the product launching, so we delight our customers with products beyond their expectations.

The ADB Team needs an experienced Program Manager to help us build and execute programs to validate the customer experience during the product development cycle. You will work with end users and a wide variety of internal teams to develop the strategy and execute the program to confirm from a customer perspective we are ready to launch. You will be a “hands on” contributor to support and troubleshoot issues, resolve problems, and keep the feedback flowing. Along the way, you’ll identify opportunities for improvements and put processes and tools in place to help us scale. You will track, communicate status, and independently drive issues to resolution. Cross-team coordination, program management, and an ability to learn and understand new technologies are essential.

Overview::

**Project Coordinator - HGA Community+Live, Workplace & Government Architecture Team!**

Location: **San Francisco, CA**

HGA is seeking a **Project Coordinator** to join our Community + Live, Workplace & Government Architecture team in our San Francisco, CA. This role plays a key part in driving project success across all phases—from early design through documentation and construction.

The Project Coordinator independently manages tasks of moderate size and complexity while supporting project teams with strong communication, technical capability, and organizational skill. Working under general supervision, this role contributes to design development, coordinates with consultants, engages directly with clients, and assists in preparing critical project deliverables. The position also begins to take on mentorship responsibilities, helping guide junior staff and modeling sound judgment in both design and technical decision-making.

**In this role you will:**

**Design & Documentation**

  

* Independently develop architectural drawings, details, and design layouts.
* Conduct design analyses and planning studies to inform project direction.
* Prepare construction documents using Revit and AutoCAD with minimal oversight.
* Compile and analyze data to support design decisions and project goals.
* Assist in writing specifications and coordinating building systems.

**Project Coordination**

  

* Manage assigned portions of project scope, schedule, and deliverables.
* Collaborate with consultants and internal teams to ensure design alignment.
* Review submittals, RFIs, and drawings for compliance and clarity.
* Support construction administration through site visits and field reports.
* Maintain organized documentation and contribute to project records.

**Communication & Collaboration**

  

* Communicate effectively with Project Managers, Principals, and consultants.
* Participate in design meetings and contribute to collaborative problem-solving.
* Present ideas clearly and document decisions for team reference.
* Mentor junior staff and contribute to a culture of learning and accountability.

**Professional Growth**

  

* Continue developing expertise in codes, specifications, and construction processes.
* Seek opportunities to lead design tasks and contribute to project strategy.
* Expand proficiency in BIM workflows and project management tools.
* Demonstrate initiative, technical rigor, and a commitment to design excellence.

**What you will need to have:**

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in architecture from an accredited institution.
* 5–7 years of professional experience.
* Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, SketchUp, Rhino, Adobe Creative Suite, and Microsoft Office.
* Familiarity with BIM workflows and project management tools (e.g., VantagePoint).

**Salary Information:**

The pay range listed aligns to the geography of the office for which this position is posted. Actual compensation will be based upon work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level and will be finalized at the time of offer. Individuals in this role working more than 24 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in HGA’s robust benefit programs which include an annual bonus and success sharing bonus program, 401(k) guaranteed contribution, paid parental leave, medical, dental and life insurance plans as well as PTO and short- and long-term disability programs. Salary Range: $84,000 - $92,000 **depending on qualifications and experience**.

**Additional Information:**

HGA is a place where you can do your best work. We believe that enduring, impactful design results from deep insight into the people and passions that animate each unique environment. We value empathy, are fueled by curiosity, and embrace the hard work that leads to innovation. Equally important is our commitment to creating a culture of inclusivity and diversity where we encourage your originality, respect the need for flexibility and work-life balance, and empower your desired career growth. HGA is a national award-winning interdisciplinary design firm rooted in architecture and engineering.

Learn more about us **here****.**

**Application Requirements & Instructions**  
Please submit resume and portfolio for consideration.

Title: Quality Assurance Technician

Full-Time | Non-Exempt | Hourly

Department: Quality

ABOUT PETIT POT

Petit Pot is a growing food manufacturing company based in Emeryville, CA. We produce high-quality French-inspired desserts and are proud to be a Certified B Corporation, balancing purpose and profit while considering the impact of our decisions on our employees, customers, community, and the environment.

POSITION SUMMARY

The QA Technician is responsible for ensuring that all production paperwork is completed, collected, organized, reviewed, and filed to the satisfaction of all pertinent regulatory agencies and customers. Ensure the site is always audit-ready by maintaining GMP, Organic, SQF, and any other certifications. Ensure the quality of all incoming ingredients, batches, and finished products. Perform required quality testing of products and records accurate product specifications in a timely manner. The ideal candidate will have a good understanding of food safety protocols, quality control processes, and regulatory compliance in the food manufacturing industry.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Maintain a solid and up-to-date understanding of all regulatory issues pertaining to the completion, review, and filing of production paperwork.

- Maintain a solid and up-to-date understanding of all customer requirements and preferences pertaining to the completion, review, and filing of production paperwork.

- Collect all production paperwork, ensuring that any missing paperwork is located.

- Provide aggressive reporting and retraining for all incomplete, incorrect, or non-compliant paperwork.

- Organize paperwork per established filing system.

- Review paperwork, ensuring that all process CCP’s, quality specifications, and customer requirements have been met. Any product affected by deviations or missing records must be reported to QA Manager and placed on QA hold.

- Manage filing systems such that all completed and reviewed records are maintained and accessible for the time required by customers and regulatory agencies.

- Release product.

- Provide assistance/support as needed with the customer, government, and third-party audits.

- Ensure all products meet the customer and product requirements.

- Always keep all work areas and equipment within SQF standards and clean.

- Ensure all personal protective equipment is always properly worn.

- Ensure all equipment is set up, calibrated, and functioning properly throughout your shift.

- Keep all equipment that is used clean, in your area always, and prepared for the next run.

- Perform several checks to the batches such as Color, pH & sensory, vacuum and % solid.

- Obtain batch samples by opening kettles, turning off agitators, ladle the samples, place samples in beakers, and take them to QC Bench for testing.

- Obtain liquid ingredient samples from bulk containers and perform testing on them.

- Recommend adjustments be made to batches by adding or subtracting ingredients.

- Monitor the Filler Machine and lines by checking the weights, charts, codes, labeling, pasteurizer temperatures and perform hourly finished product analysis.

- Verify codes and charts very closely - the ink can run dry and codes can be set wrong.

- Perform visual checks and record results, weigh product on calibrated scales, obtain and bring the samples to the QC bench for testing, perform tests, and record results.

- Place batches of finished products on hold as required.

- Copy batch cards as required for kitchen operators.

- All other assigned duties required during your work period.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

- GED or High School Diploma

- Previous QA experience in a food manufacturing environment.

- Ability to work with numbers, perform calculations, and possess mechanical abilities.

- Ability to identify food safety concerns or risks.

- Demonstrated ability to work independently, with limited supervision.

- Communication skills: must be able to communicate and work closely with all departments and management levels.

- Keep up with a fast-paced work environment and record data as required in a timely manner.

- Extreme attention to detail.

- Strong organizational ability.

- Good communication skills (both written and verbal).

- General computer proficiency (Word, Excel, etc.).

- Ability to attend and successfully complete related training programs.

- Spanish (Plus, not required)

EQUIPMENT AND TOOLS USED

- Use the following equipment: Refractometer, Salt Titrator, Acid Titrator, PH Meter, Color Meter, Moisture Meter, Viscometer, and Consistometer, various gages, torque meters and other equipment as required.

- Handcarts and pallet jacks.

- Forklift (not all QC Techs.)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- SQF Certified (Plus, not required)

- PCQI Certified (Plus, not required)

- HACCP Certified (Plus, not required)

- Experience in the food manufacturing industry required.

- Knowledge of food safety regulations, quality standards, and production best practices.

- Experience with lean manufacturing, process improvement, or waste reduction is a plus.

- Experience in dessert, dairy, pudding, or refrigerated food production is a plus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT/CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

- Varied temperature work areas.

- The environment is very wet, slippery, and has continuous forklift traffic.

- Handle and work around various moving equipment and chemicals.

- Frequent use of hot/cold water to perform checks and clean equipment and area.

- Frequent lifting objects < 30 lbs. and pushing/pulling of objects less than <80 lbs. on carts.

- Long term standing, constantly moving around on foot, frequent bending, and constant climbing of stairs. (Mus

### **TITLE:** **Supervisor, Food Safety & Quality Assurance**

### **DEPARTMENT:** **Quality Assurance**

### **REPORTS TO:** **Manager, Food Safety & Quality Assurance**

### **WHO WE ARE:**

Thistle makes it easy to eat well – without overthinking it. Thistle was founded in 2013 with a mission to help people get and stay healthy while improving the sustainability of our food system. Thistle delivers fully prepared, healthy-by-default meals, snacks, desserts, and organic cold-pressed juices. We believe the health of people starts with eating real, whole foods, in the right balance, without the friction. We’re building a future where nutritious, sustainable food is accessible, craveable, and part of everyday life.

### **About the Role**

The Food Safety & Quality Assurance Supervisor oversees aspects of Quality Management Systems, food safety regulatory Compliance, 3rd Party Food Safety certifications, and Customer Safety & Satisfaction. The FSQA Supervisor is responsible for conducting audits in accordance with food safety and quality management systems. They will collaborate with teams to generate and implement key initiatives aimed at protecting and enhancing the quality of food products at Thistle. The FSQA Supervisor is responsible for overseeing standardized quality control checks to ensure they meet the required legal and company standards for food safety and quality. This role is required to maintain calibrations, monitor equipment, check product integrity, and identify areas for quality control improvement.

### **How You’ll Make a Difference**

* Hire, train, evaluate, assign work, and supervise FSQA and Sanitation associates.
* Ensures the Quality Assurance department functions efficiently and accurately and complies with set company standards, including GMPs, HACCP guidelines, and food safety processes.
* Document, review, and approve all relevant food safety and quality documentation(manuals, procedures, SSOPs, HACCP, Pre-requisite programs etc.)
* Ensure Quality Management Systems and Food Safety programs comply with the regulatory requirements and 3rd party food safety standards (local, state, federal, GMP, SQF)
* Assist with Supplier and Co-packer Approval, Verification, and Monitoring programs including new supplier qualification processes and onboarding
* Oversee chemical approval program
* Ensure allergen program, allergen declaration per recipe, and labeling requirements are met
* Conduct internal audits to monitor food quality, processes, facilities, and quality systems.
* Conduct pre-operational line inspections and residual swabs.
* Calibrate critical equipment- thermometers, pH meters, scales etc.
* Oversee the environmental testing program.

### **Who You Are**

* BA/BS Degree in Biology, Nutrition, Environmental Health, Microbiology, or related field.
* 3+ years of experience and knowledge of food safety programs are required.
* At least 2+ years of supervisory experience in a food safety environment
* Strong communication (both written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.
* Well-developed organization and time management skills.
* Food Handlers Certification (state-appropriate equivalent)

jobs.title: Quality Manager
jobs.description:
**About Rivet**  
Rivet is an American company building integrated task systems — fusing hardened hardware with software, sensors, AI, and networking — for industrial workforces and defense personnel. We create capabilities that multiply the effectiveness of every individual and withstand the world’s toughest environments.  
  
We serve the people who build, operate, maintain, and defend our way of life. From technicians and engineers to first responders and service members, they embody the hard work, ingenuity, and meritocratic values that drive Western prosperity. Yet too often they are forced to rely on outdated tools that fail under modern pressures. Rivet exists to reset that priority.  
  
At Rivet, you’ll join a mission-driven team that fuses disciplines to deliver decisive outcomes where they matter most. Whether shaping our technology, strengthening our partnerships, or building our culture, every role here contributes to equipping the front lines with the modern systems they deserve.  
  
**Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).**

**Summary**

Rivet Industries builds rugged hardware and software for defense and industrial frontline workers. We are looking for an experienced Quality Manager to build and lead quality across the company, from the first prototype through shipped product in the field.

This is the first dedicated quality leadership role at Rivet. You will own the quality system end to end, grow a small team, and set the standard our contract manufacturers, suppliers and internal teams build to. Our products are made with contract manufacturers overseas today, and we are standing up US manufacturing alongside them, so you will build a quality program that works across both.

You will lead every quality function in the org.

* Supplier quality: contract manufacturer and component supplier quality, including audits, qualification, incoming inspection, SCARs and supplier scorecards
* In-house quality engineering: inspection plans, process controls, first article inspection and line quality for our US builds
* Company quality system: the QMS itself, including ISO 9001 certification (with a path toward AS9100), document control, internal audits, CAPA and management review
* Software quality: release quality standards and test gates for the software that ships on and with our hardware, in partnership with Software
* Compliance: oversight of trade compliance, regulatory and product certifications, environmental compliance and safety

**Responsibilities**

* Define and run Rivet's quality strategy, policies and metrics, and report quality performance to Operations and executive leadership
* Build, implement and maintain a QMS that achieves ISO 9001 certification and scales toward AS9100 and defense customer requirements
* Lead supplier and contract manufacturer quality: qualification audits, quality agreements, process audits, SCARs and corrective action through closure
* Set up quality for US in-house manufacturing, including inspection, first article inspection, process controls and nonconforming material review
* Own quality gates across NPI: DFM/DFT input, PFMEA and control plans, build readiness reviews and production release criteria
* Run a closed-loop CAPA process and lead 8D investigations on significant escapes
* Partner with Software to set release quality standards and test gates for shipped software
* Oversee compliance across trade (export controls such as ITAR/EAR), product regulatory certifications, environmental (RoHS, REACH) and safety, and support customer and government audits
* Work with Engineering, Program Management, Supply Chain and Manufacturing to make quality a design and build requirement, not an end-of-line check
* Hire, develop and lead a team of quality, reliability and compliance engineers as the company grows

**Required qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related technical field
* 10+ years in quality engineering or quality management for electronic or electromechanical hardware
* 5+ years leading quality teams or a quality function
* Hands-on experience managing contract manufacturers and suppliers, including overseas (Asia) manufacturing
* Experience building or running an ISO 9001 QMS and leading a company through certification or surveillance audits
* Deep working knowledge of quality tools: FMEA, control plans, SPC, MSA, first article inspection, 8D and root cause analysis
* Experience taking products from NPI through volume production
* Ability to work across engineering, operations and leadership, and to set direction without a large existing team
* Willingness to travel to contract manufacturers and suppliers (domestic and international)
* Ability to meet U.S. export control (ITAR) requirements

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience in defense, aerospace or other regulated hardware (AS9100, MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-461, DFARS flow-downs)
* Startup or early-stage experience building a quality function from the ground up
* Experience standing up a new US factory or production line
* Familiarity with IPC-A-610 / J-STD-001 workmanship standards
* Experience with export, environmental and product certification programs
* Experience with a PLM/QMS system (for example Arena)
* ASQ certification (CQE, CQM/OE or CRE) or Six Sigma Black Belt

Compensation may vary within the posted range based on relevant experience, skills, education, and other job-related factors. **Description**

**About CoreSite:**

CoreSite is a leading colocation data center company providing the space, power, cooling and connectivity that businesses rely on to operate and grow. Our data centers bring dozens of organizations together under one roof, supporting the technology and services that keep our world connected. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, bringing the expertise, ideas and commitment that power our business and help our customers succeed. With a culture built on collaboration, ownership, and operational excellence, CoreSite is a place to make an impact.

**Commissioning Program Manager - Data Center:**

As a member of the company's Engineering team, the Commissioning Program Manager is responsible for leading the planning, execution, and delivery of commissioning activities across data center projects, including greenfield builds, expansions, and system upgrades. This role ensures that all mechanical, electrical, and control systems are designed, installed, tested, and validated to meet performance, quality, and operational readiness requirements. You will collaborate closely with design teams, contractors, commissioning authorities, operations, and cross‑functional stakeholders to oversee commissioning plans, testing protocols, documentation, and issue resolution. This role requires technical leadership, strong project management capability, and deep fluency in mission‑critical systems and commissioning standards.

* As the owner's representative, oversee Level 1-5 commissioning reviews and execution, ensuring testing validates performance against specifications.
* Oversee the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of internal commissioning standards, procedures, SOWs, and NETA standards.
* Participate in system integration testing to ensure seamless operation across all critical systems.

* Support commissioning activities, scopes, and stakeholder communications throughout the project lifecycle.

* Review and standardize commissioning scripts, including templates for critical equipment, to ensure system testing meets industry standards, owner requirements, operational criteria, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Drive quality control measures for testing, inspection documentation, and issue tracking for continuous improvement.

**Documentation & Reporting:**

* Develop and maintain comprehensive system for tracking and storing commissioning documentation, including test results, reports, and as‑built records.
* Represent the owner in project commissioning meetings, communicate commissioning progress to internal stakeholders, and maintain Engineering Team alignment and engagement throughout the commissioning lifecycle.
* Manage commissioning scope definition and CxA procurement while ensuring effective onboarding, documentation management, and reporting for third-party commissioning teams.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

Whether understanding and solving their online content concerns, navigating within global legal frameworks, or writing and enforcing worldwide policy, the Trust & Safety team is on the frontlines of enhancing the YouTube experience, building internet safety, and protecting free speech in our ever-evolving digital world.
  
  
As a part of the Adversarial Abuse Policy Development team within Trust and Safety, you will operate on the front lines of platform defense. You will not play by traditional rules but rapidly adapt to our defenses, executing coordinated spam campaigns, synthetic media impersonations, and sophisticated monetization scams. As a Policy Development Lead for AI and Adversarial Integrity, you will lead global policy frameworks that address the dual frontier of Artificial Intelligence. You will design durable, machine-enforceable policies to detect and mitigate malicious uses of generative AI, including evasive botnets, mass-produced synthetic slop, and deepfake impersonations. You will pioneer the use of internal generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) tooling to analyze complex threat patterns, stress-test policy boundaries, and prototype enforcement frameworks at YouTube scale.  
  
In this role, you will act as the critical bridge between behavioral threat analysis, machine learning engineering, operations, and product strategy. You will unpack adversarial business models and author robust enforcement guidelines that safeguard the YouTube ecosystem.At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $136000 - $196000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead the end-to-end development, implementation, and life-cycle governance of global policies targeting scaled adversarial abuse, generative AI exploitation, coordinated spam networks, and inorganic platform manipulation.

jobs.title: Patient Experience Coordinator (Pacific Time)
jobs.description:
Heartbeat Health is the leading virtual-first cardiovascular care company in the country, providing patients with convenient, high-quality heart care through a combination of telemedicine, diagnostics, and virtual care programs. By leveraging real-time data and AI-powered insights, Heartbeat Health empowers providers and patients with personalized treatment plans, reducing hospitalizations and improving long-term heart health outcomes. Heartbeat Health is redefining how cardiovascular care is delivered in the digital age, led by our medical group of cardiologists, advanced practitioners, nurses, and care coordinators.

  

### **About the Job:**

We are seeking a Patient Experience Coordinator to join our virtual clinic team. This is a full-time, remote position requiring availability to work Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time (PST/PDT).

This entry-level opportunity is ideal for individuals who are passionate about delivering exceptional patient experiences and eager to grow their careers in the healthcare technology industry. As a Patient Experience Coordinator, you will serve as a key point of contact for patients, helping them navigate their cardiovascular care journey while ensuring a seamless and supportive experience.

Key Responsibilities:

* **Patient Outreach & Engagement:** Proactively connect with patients via phone, text, and email to coordinate virtual appointments, schedule diagnostic testing (such as stress tests and echocardiograms), and support ongoing patient engagement.
* **Patient Support & Experience:** Deliver a high-quality, concierge-level experience by assisting patients with technical questions, navigating virtual care platforms, and ensuring they feel informed and supported throughout their care journey.
* **Operational Support:** Maintain accurate patient information, document interactions, identify opportunities for process improvement, and support efficient daily clinic operations.
* **Collaboration & Growth:** Work closely with clinical and operational teams to improve patient workflows, support new healthcare programs, and contribute to the continued growth of our virtual care services.

### **About You:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, such as Social Work, Communications, Education, Sociology, Psychology, Health Sciences, or a related discipline.
* **Experience:** At least 6 months of professional work or internship experience, preferably in a customer-facing or service-oriented environment.
* **Customer Service Focus:** Experience in high-touch, customer-facing roles such as hospitality, retail, food service, or call centers, with the ability to navigate fast-paced environments while maintaining professionalism and empathy.
* **People-Oriented:** Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a passion for helping others, building relationships, and creating positive experiences.
* **Mission-Driven:** Genuine enthusiasm for supporting patients and making a meaningful impact on their healthcare experience and outcomes.
* **Tech-Savvy & Adaptable:** Comfortable navigating technology, maintaining accurate records, and learning new systems and healthcare platforms in a fast-paced, virtual environment.
* **Organization & Attention to Detail:** Ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain accurate documentation, and provide timely follow-up to ensure a seamless patient experience.
* **Schedule Availability:** Ability to consistently work Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time (PST/PDT), regardless of location.

### **About Our Culture:**

* **We are mission-driven:** we're revolutionizing the way cardiovascular care is delivered
* **We are fast-paced & agile:** we move quickly, iterate often, and value experimentation
* **We are remote-first:** ownership, autonomy, and trust are at the core of how we operate
* **We care about diversity**: diversity allows us to build an excellent patient experience
* **We care about each other:** we are stronger together through a culture of mutual respect and active support.
* **We invest in our people:** Eligible employees have access to a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid holidays, sick time, a 401(k), and additional benefits designed to support you and your family.
* **We are an equal opportunity employer:** we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status

$24 - $26 an hour

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Clinical Program Manager
jobs.description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.
  
  
**Job Description**

The **Clinical Program Manager** is responsible for the worldwide execution of all Phase I - IV clinical trials across all Gilead therapeutic areas. Clinical Operations plays a key role in ensuring all Gilead clinical trials are performed in accordance with applicable SOPs, company policies and regulatory guidelines to provide timely and high-quality clinical data that supports global registration and commercialization of Gilead’s products.

  

You will oversee and be responsible for the successful execution of studies and/or multiple studies within a program or multiple programs, including financial responsibility. You will be responsible for the resource management of studies, including ongoing assessment of resource needs and optimal deployment of resources to support a fluid ‘One Ops’ workforce.

  

You will participate and engage in Clinical Operations and/or cross-functional organizational change initiatives. You may act as the business process owner (BPO) and/or serve as a subject matter expert for Clinical Operations processes. You will encourage an innovative mindset by championing new ideas and initiatives and incorporating best practices, external benchmarking, and standardization across Clinical Operations.

  

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Provides ongoing financial oversight of clinical trials/programs assigned.
* May provide input into strategic and operational short- and long-range therapeutic area / functional area plans as appropriate, including supporting alignment and communications to other team members upon implementation.
* Provides guidance and oversight for the successful management of all aspects of clinical trials within designated program budgets and timelines.
* Leads cross-functional Study Management Teams (SMTs) and influences all relevant stakeholders.
* Partners with cross-functional teams to manage, adjust and revise project timelines and budgets as needed.
* Communicates project status and issues and ensures project team goals are met in alignment with project decisions. Escalates issues as needed.
* Participates in the development of all study-related documentation, including study protocols.
* Participates in the selection, management and oversight of contract research organizations (CROs) / vendors, including development of requests for proposals (RFPs).
* Anticipates obstacles and difficulties and implements solutions to achieve project goals, including risk assessment and mitigation strategies.
* Resolves issues as needed within national and international regulations and guidelines.
* Uses all available tools to track, oversee and communicate on program status to all key stakeholders.
* Participates in and/or leads departmental or interdepartmental strategic initiatives.
* As assigned, initiates, authors, or otherwise contributes to standard operating procedure (SOP) development, implementation, and training.
* Responsible for Clinical Operations activities conducted by the affiliate that are required by local regulations and/or usual practice to support clinical trials.
* Ensures team’s work complies with established practices, policies and processes, and any regulatory or other requirements.
People Leader Path: Hires, develops, and retains diverse top talent on the team. Sets clear expectations for direct reports, and coaches direct reports on their performance, development and career interests.  

  

**Basic Requirements:**

* BA / BS / RN with 8 or more years’ relevant clinical or related experience in life sciences or MA / MS / PharmD / PhD with 6 or more years’ relevant clinical or related experience in life sciences.
Minimum of 4 years’ cross-functional study management or related leadership experience in life sciences, including multiple years’ experience managing study or project teams.  

  

**Preferred Requirements:**

* Advanced knowledge of one or more disease or therapeutic areas, as evidenced by independence in designing, implementing, and managing study team plans, deliverables and resource management.
* Experience developing RFPs and selection and oversight/management of CROs or other vendors.
* Proven ability to successfully start-up, manage and close-out clinical studies, including authoring clinical study and regulatory documentation and SOPs.
* Complete knowledge of full cycle study management, from start-up to close-out.
* Advanced knowledge of study management best practices and tools and has shown ability to apply these to improve study efficiencies and effectiveness.
* Thorough knowledge of Food & Drug Administration (FDA) and European Medicines Agency (EMA), and other applicable national regulations, International Council for Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Pharmaceuticals for Human Use (ICH) guidelines and Good Clinical Practice (GCP) governing the conduct
