jobs.title: Service Delivery Manager
jobs.description:
At Ensono, our Purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and unleashing our clients to Do Great Things! We enable our clients to achieve key business outcomes that reshape how our world runs. As an expert technology adviser and managed service provider with cross-platform certifications, Ensono empowers our clients to keep up with continuous change and embrace innovation.

We can Do Great Things because we have great Associates. The Ensono Core Values unify our diverse talents and are woven into how we do business. These five traits are the key to achieving our purpose:

Honesty, Reliability, Curiosity, Collaboration, and Passion.

About the role and what you’ll be doing:

The Service Delivery Manager (SDM) is the primary operational advocate and point of contact for assigned clients. Working across Ensono delivery, support, and account teams, the SDM coordinates contracted services, monitors service performance, supports issue resolution, and helps align day-to-day delivery with client expectations and desired business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage day-to-day service delivery for assigned accounts, monitoring SLAs, SLOs, KPIs, and contractual commitments.
* Serve as the primary operational contact for client stakeholders, partnering with the Client Executive and delivery teams.
* Facilitate weekly operational reviews and support MBRs and QBRs by preparing clear service metrics, updates, and action items.
* Coordinate incident communications, escalations, root cause reviews, and follow-up actions with the appropriate delivery teams.
* Support change, release, and maintenance coordination, helping manage client impact and stakeholder communication.
* Maintain governance artifacts, action logs, risk registers, Service Improvement Plans, and audit documentation.
* Support account financial activities, including billing validation, consumption reporting, budget tracking, and cost optimization.
* Use performance trends, client feedback, and Ensono Portal insights to identify and track continuous improvement opportunities.
* Coordinate cross-functional resources and dependencies, escalating delivery blockers when needed.
* Support client onboarding and service transitions, including knowledge transfer and operational readiness.

We want all new Associates to succeed in their roles at Ensono. That’s why we’ve outlined the job requirements below. To be considered for this role, it’s important that you meet all Required Qualifications. If you do not meet all the Preferred Qualifications, we still encourage you to apply.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree and at least four years of related experience, or equivalent work experience, in service delivery, client services, or IT operations.
* Experience supporting client accounts in an MSP or complex IT environment.
* Working knowledge of ITIL service management principles; ITIL certification is preferred.
* Ability to build effective client relationships, facilitate operational governance, and manage routine escalations with appropriate support.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to track actions, risks, and service performance.
* Working knowledge of budget tracking, consumption reporting, and billing validation.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow and hybrid technology environments, such as mainframe, infrastructure, cloud, databases, middleware, virtualization, and networking.
* Working knowledge of AI tools, prompting, and agents to improve productivity and client insights.
* Strong written, presentation, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to work effectively across matrixed, cross-functional, and global delivery teams.
* Willingness to travel as required and participate in structured on-call escalation coverage.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL certification and experience supporting client onboarding or service transitions.
* Knowledge of client industry practices, trends, and regulatory considerations.

**Why Ensono?**
---------------

Ensono is a place to make better happen – for our clients and for your career. You can do great things through innovation or collaboration, by learning or volunteering, or to promote diversity and inclusion. You can do great things for your own health or for a healthier planet. Whatever it means to you to do great things, we want Ensono to be the place you can do it.

We are a client-facing business, but we do encourage clients to allow us to work remotely most of the time so if you are not required to be on a client site, you can choose to work from home or in our Ensono offices.

Some of our benefits include:

* Unlimited Paid Days Off

* Family Forming Benefit including fertility coverage and adoption/surrogacy reimbursement
* Paid childbearing and paternal leave

jobs.title: Customer Experience Operations Manager, Business Unit
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

Our Customer Experience team owns the full post-sales lifecycle for one of Rippling’s largest business units, from onboarding and implementation to escalations and renewals—we’re united by a passion for customers and continuous improvement, and we’re committed to personal and professional growth.

In this role, you're expected to be a builder: you’ll design and run the post-sales operating model for the business unit from the ground up. Our model runs on a lean, task-based system where every motion is defined, measured, and repeatable. You’ll define what success looks like, set the KPIs, map and build the workflows, write the playbooks, and keep refining the machine as the business grows.

You will also bridge data and day-to-day execution: building multi-factor health scores, engineering automated risk interventions, refining lifecycle touch points across the whole Product Experience to maximize retention outcomes.

Last, you’ll be the technical architect of the systems behind it and be the main business partner to CX leadership. You’ll find the truth in the data, turn it into action, and own the outcome.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Build the post-sales operating model for the business unit: define success at each lifecycle stage, set the KPIs, and design how work flows across onboarding, implementation, customer success, escalations, and renewals.
* Own the architecture, data integrity, and configuration of our CX systems. Partner cross-functionally on integrations across CRM, billing, support, and product analytics.
* Analyze intervention outcomes to understand why accounts churn or save, and use what you learn to refine playbooks and train the team on save and de-escalation strategies.
* Establish automated early warning systems that detect leading indicators of churn well before renewal windows open.
* Develop proactive intervention playbooks mapped to specific risk triggers (e.g., missed payments, steep drops in platform activity, repeated support escalations).
* Own the customer sentiment program (NPS, CSAT): build and administer lifecycle-triggered surveys, analyze trends across customer segments, and run a closed-loop detractor playbook.
* Prepare and run weekly business reviews, and deliver weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting on gross and net retention, save rates, health score trends, and operational capacity.
* Manage and mentor a team of Retention Specialists through regular 1:1s, performance coaching, and workflow reviews. Set the SOPs, turnaround targets, and escalation protocols they work from.
* Partner with Product, Sales, and Support to surface upstream product frictions, onboarding bottlenecks, or misaligned customer expectations that contribute to churn.

**Who you are**
---------------

* **A builder.** You want to build the right system or workflow rather than inherit it; you’re comfortable in ambiguity, and you’ve done that before.
* **An owner.** When you see a problem, you act with urgency and you proactively own it until it’s solved; you are effective as a cross-functional operator.
* **A truth seeker.** You go to the data and to the frontline, you challenge assumptions (including your own), and make decisions based on what’s actually happening.
* **Thorough.** You sweat the details in workflows, data, and documentation, because a system is only as good as its details. You keep making the process better.

**What you will have**
----------------------

* 3–10+ years of experience in Customer Success Operations, RevOps, or CX Management within a B2B SaaS environment.
* 1+ years of direct people management or lead experience guiding retention, support, or customer success specialists.
* Experience building operations from the ground up in a high-growth environment.
* Track record of designing retention programs, renewal/save programs, and/or building automated risk-alert frameworks tied directly to measurable retention gains.
* Technical comfort owning and building systems; You're comfortable with SFDC, Jira, and/or CSP platforms (e.g. Vitally, Gainsight or ChurnZero), navigating API integrations, bi-directional syncing, and event-based tracking schemas.
* Strong data literacy; proficient in mapping SaaS metrics (NRR, GRR, Churn, LTV, Adoption velocity) and synthesizing raw analytics into operational priorities.
* Emerging AI Tooling Experience: you are comfortable integrating LLMs (e.g., Claude, OpenAI APIs) into CX tech stacks for automated ticket summarization, health score analysis, or retention playbook drafting.

**Additional Information**

jobs.description:
### **About the role**

Databricks bills customers on usage. Every month, millions of usage records turn into commit drawdowns, invoices and revenue. The Revenue Operations team within Order to Cash organization makes sure that happens accurately and on time.

We're hiring a **Revenue Operations Manager** to oversee usage operations and improve how contracts move from booking to invoicing. A key focus is Universal Commitment, our cloud-agnostic commit model. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Revenue Operations, you'll lead key month-end close activities for our billing and rating platform, oversee a team based in India, and drive process and automation improvements across Revenue Operations.

You'll work closely with the **Order to Revenue Process Compliance** team. That team sets usage policy, leads root-cause analysis and owns governance. Your team carries out the work: applying adjustments, keeping usage and billing in balance, and making sure each correction is documented, reviewed and fully reflected in our systems.

### **What you'll do**

#### **Revenue operations and contract setup**

* Own the booking review process. Validate orders in the booking queue and serve as the escalation point for upstream teams on complex contract structures.
* Make sure contract and usage settings are correct across our billing and rating platform, ERP and CPQ, so that Universal Commitment and other contract type invoice as intended.
* Advise Deal Desk and Revenue Assurance on whether non-standard terms can be billed (e.g., GPU reservations, per-hour pricing, custom SKUs) before deals close. Provide guidance on new product offerings and ensure operational feasibility prior to finance sign off.
* Define and report Revenue Operations KPIs, such as adjustment volume, close timeliness, and billing accuracy.

#### **Usage operations and adjustments**

* Oversee and approve usage adjustments, billing corrections and customer credits in DBAR and the ERP. This covers billing errors, SLA credits and customer satisfaction (CSAT) credits, in line with Usage Compliance policies and approval levels.
* Serve as the escalation point for manual usage processing, including manual usage uploads, reservation and non-standard billing, ledger entries, and retract-and-restate corrections, with a full audit trail.
* Make sure usage-to-contract mapping, including customer workspace moves, PAYG-to-commit conversions and mid-term contract changes, with the correct effective dates.
* Act as the Revenue Operations owner of the refund and credit process, from intake, and validation through execution.
* Approve or deny account provisioning requests (suspend, unsuspend, grace-period extensions) with the Network Operations Center (NOC).
* Oversee usage tracking for customers with special provisions and non-standard language in their order form.

#### **Month-end and quarter-end close**

* Lead our contract reconciliation which ingests and compares usage across all clouds at the contractual level. Partner with Engineering, from pre-close through delivery of the final usage file to Revenue Accounting .
* Run usage categorization and commit and PAYG reconciliations, between the billing platform and the ERP across all clouds.
* Own billing finalization (Billing Mass Finalization / ledger freeze), the step that closes each month.
* Partner with the Revenue Accounting on usage flux analysis and contribute to shorten the close timeline.
* Act as preparer and/or reviewer for assigned SOX controls (e.g., usage reconciliation and SKU pricing accuracy) and keep audit evidence ready.Align with RevOps team to continue to improve recon process by assimilating processes across all clouds. Oversee Universal Commit contract reconciliation to ensure completeness.

#### **Team leadership and scale**

* Lead and develop the GBS usage team (India). Set priorities, review work, and steadily expand team ownership.Write, maintain and centrally store SOPs for every recurring process, and make sure each critical close task has a trained backup.
* Use SQL and Databricks dashboards to automate reconciliations and reduce manual effort, working toward touchless billing.

#### **Cross-functional partnership**

* Partner with the Usage Compliance team. Hand off recurring adjustment patterns and supporting data for root-cause analysis, put new policies into practice, and report adjustment volume and status.
* Work with the Money/DBAR Engineering, IT/Business Systems, Deal Desk, Billing, Collections and Revenue Accounting teams to resolve usage and billing issues quickly.
* Serve as subject matter expert on strategic initiatives and projects by working with our commercialization team, engineering, and other GTM and Accounting teams. Will require driving project initiatives in certain cases.

### **What we're looking for**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business or a related field.
* 6+ years in revenue operations, billing operations or order-to-cash, ideally with usage- or consumption-based billing.
* 2+ years managing people, including leading offshore or shared-service teams.
* Hands-on experience with billing or rating systems and a major ERP (e.g., SAP, NetSuite or Oracle), plus Salesforce/CPQ.
* Strong SQL skills. Experience with Databricks is a plus.
* Track record of running month-end close tasks on time, with SOX controls.
* Experience leading or guiding offshore or shared-services teams.
* Clear written communication and a habit of documenting your work and sharing knowledge openly.

**Nice to have**

* Establish consistent purchasing controls, decision rights, and escalation processes.

### **Business Performance & Accountability**

* Establish KPIs for the buying function and individual Buyers, with regular reviews and clear ownership of corrective actions.
* Report purchasing performance, inventory health, risks, and recommendations to the EVP, Product.
* Use data to prioritize process improvements and strengthen execution across categories.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.
* 8+ years of experience in buying, purchasing, merchandising, or category management, ideally in distribution, wholesale, or the collectibles and hobby industry.
* 4+ years directly leading and developing buying or merchandising teams.

**About Henry Meds:**  
Henry Meds is a direct-to-consumer telehealth company on a mission to create a world where everyone has the health to live fully– regardless of insurance status or plan. As a telehealth organization delivering virtual health care to patients in 40 states and DC through a professional corporation–management services organization ("PC-MSO") model, clinical care is delivered by physician-owned professional entities, and Henry Meds provides administrative, technology, and business support services under management services agreements.

We're headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, with a largely remote U.S. team. We work under a guiding principle that puts patients first, driven by five values: Integrity Always, Own It, Be Relentless, Stay Curious, and Win Together. We are driven to fulfil our mission and create a great place to work.

Enjoy the casual culture, remote-first workplace, and generous PTO/benefits!

Apply today to make a direct, daily impact in one of the fastest-growing startups in the country - we are excited to meet you!

  

**Position Overview:**

The Patient Advocate I is a primary frontline contact for Henry Meds patients. This role resolves standard non-clinical needs through phone, voicemail, email, chat, and other approved channels. The Patient Advocate I owns the patient interaction, completes authorized actions, coordinates internal help when needed, and keeps the patient informed through resolution.

  

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

#### **Patient Support**

* Communicate with patients by phone, email, and chat using timely, empathetic, and ownership-driven service.
* Work as a generalist across phone, email, chat, voicemail, billing, account support, subscriptions, scheduling, refill support, portal navigation, order support, and other approved non-clinical workflows.
* Accept channel and work-type assignments based on patient needs, volume, staffing, and operational priorities rather than individual preference.
* Resolve standard questions involving accounts, subscriptions, billing, scheduling, refill processes, portal use, intake forms, and order status.
* Guide new and existing patients through Henry systems and established care processes.
* Troubleshoot basic platform and account-access issues.
* Use approved retention and service-recovery options when appropriate.

#### **Case Ownership and Coordination**

* Own assigned patient needs from first contact through documented resolution.
* Complete authorized actions in the CRM, EHR, billing platform, and related systems.
* Manage the non-clinical portion of requests that also require clinical action.
* Explain next steps, expected timing, and any action required from the patient.
* Escalate stalled or unresolved work through the defined operating path.

#### **Clinical Boundaries and Compliance**

* Recognize possible symptoms, side effects, medication questions, and other clinical content.
* Route clinical matters to Patient Safety or the appropriate licensed team without providing clinical advice.
* Protect patient confidentiality and follow HIPAA, privacy, security, and documentation requirements.

#### **Quality and Improvement**

* Follow approved daily work assignments, queue priorities, coverage direction, and workflow guidance issued by the Manager or a designated Patient Advocate Leader.
* Meet established quality, accuracy, productivity, timeliness, attendance, and schedule expectations.
* Stay current on approved process, policy, product, pricing, and system changes.
* Identify unclear procedures, broken workflows, and recurring causes of repeat patient contact.

  

**You will likely have:**

* Experience in telehealth, healthcare, pharmacy support, subscription services, or regulated customer service.
* Experience with Zendesk, Zoho, an EHR, or billing platforms.

  

**You may have:**

* Previous experience in customer service, healthcare support, care coordination, a call center, or another high-volume service environment.
* Clear and compassionate verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong active listening, problem-solving, organization, and follow-through.
* Comfort learning and working across CRM, EHR, billing, and communication systems.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating with a distributed team.
* Ability to maintain clinical boundaries and follow escalation requirements.
* Commitment to patient privacy, accurate documentation, and continuous learning.

**Company Offers:**

* Platinum PPO Healthcare + Vision & Dental (Henry covers 99% for employees and 50% for their qualified dependents).
* 401(k) with matching contributions beginning your first day.
* Unlimited PTO (target of 4 weeks), 6 floating holidays, and 4 company observed holidays.
* Fully remote position with occasional travel.
* Impactful, rewarding work as part of a fast-growing brand helping thousands of people every day.

  

**Equal Opportunity Statement:**

Henry Meds is committed to promoting an inclusive work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We value a diverse and balanced team where everyone can belong.

  

**Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We cannot sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.**

**Salary Range**: $23.00 - $25.00

*This salary represents Henry Med's good faith and reasonable estimate of the possible compensation for this role at the time of posting, and Henry Meds may ultimately pay more or less than the posted salary. The final salary for this position will be determined by Henry Meds sole discretion, consistent with applicable law, and based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the employee's work experience, skills, and qualifications for the role, as well as the needs of Henry Meds business and other operational considerations.*

jobs.title: Marketing Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Marketing Account Manager**

Full-time W-2 employee · Remote, United States (excluding California) · Monday to Friday

Medical Marketing Whiz is hiring a full-time Marketing Account Manager to own the relationship with a portfolio of medical spa, aesthetics, women's health, functional medicine and weight loss practices. You will be the person our clients know by name: you set the plan, keep every project moving, and make sure each client always knows what we are working on and what comes next.

This is a full-time W-2 position, not a contract or a side project. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. We are not able to consider applicants who live in California.

**About Medical Marketing Whiz**

Medical Marketing Whiz delivers marketing strategy and execution for aesthetics and medical spas, women's health practices, functional medicine providers and weight loss clinics, including marketing programs offered through leading aesthetic device manufacturers. In 2026 we joined AscendPoint Agency, which gives our team and our clients more resources than ever.

We are known for creative campaigns, consistent execution and measurable growth. We are also moving fast toward an AI-first way of working, and we want teammates who are excited to help shape it.

**You won't be doing this alone**

You are your clients' main point of contact, but you are never the only person doing the work. Behind every account you manage is a team that handles the specialized pieces:

* **Website team:** builds, edits, hosting and maintenance
* **SEO team:** blogs, local SEO, Google Business Profile and directory listings
* **Paid ads specialist:** Meta and Google ad campaigns
* **Design and social media support:** graphics and recurring social content
* **Campaign and automation builder:** landing pages, funnels, review requests and event campaigns in GoHighLevel
* **Experienced account managers** who share what's working with their clients in our team channel every day
* **Leadership** that joins difficult client conversations, escalations and renewal or cancellation calls
* **WhizHQ**, our proprietary internal software, which connects directly to Claude, so less of your day goes to busywork

New account managers get a structured onboarding, a handoff brief for every client they take over, a weekly team meeting and regular trainings.

**What you'll do**

* Serve as the primary marketing contact for 20 or more client accounts
* Lead regular strategy calls with doctors and practice owners: review results, present ideas and recommend next steps
* Send every client a proactive update each week covering what's done, what's in progress, what's next and anything we need from them
* Plan and deliver campaigns, including email newsletters, SMS, social media, in-office and virtual events, webinars, press releases, landing pages, funnels, lead magnets and seasonal promotions
* Hand requests to the website, SEO, ads and design teams, track them in ClickUp and follow through until they are delivered
* Coach clients on following up with leads from Meta and Google ads, and on growing their email lists and reviews
* Review performance data and reports and recommend adjustments that improve results
* Keep a complete record of every client relationship in HubSpot, Slack and the client's shared folder
* Spot risk early and bring stalled projects, unhappy clients and cancellation requests to leadership right away
* Use AI every day, and help us find and build the next workflow worth improving

**How we work**

These are the habits that matter most on our team:

* **Clients never have to ask what's happening.** Every client knows who their contact is, what's in progress, what's next and when the next call is. A short check-in counts, even when there's no big news.
* **If it isn't logged, it didn't happen.** Call notes, emails and decisions go in HubSpot. Client conversations happen in that client's Slack channel, not in direct messages. A complete record protects the client, you and the company.
* **Requests go through the system.** Website edits and team requests go through ClickUp, so nothing gets lost.
* **Tell the truth and coach.** Be honest with clients about results, good or bad. When something isn't working, say so and bring a clear next step. When a client gets frustrated by things that don't move the needle, help them refocus on what grows their practice.
* **Escalate early.** If a project stalls or a client is unhappy, tell leadership before it becomes a problem. When a client mentions canceling, leadership joins the conversation right away.
* **Healthcare marketing has rules.** Press releases go out under the clinic's name. Review requests never ask patients to name a staff member. Some states restrict referral rewards. Patient privacy applies to everything we touch.
* **AI drafts, people approve.** We use AI heavily, and a person checks every word and image before a client sees it. We never use AI-generated images of a client's office, devices, providers or patients.

**Working with AI**

We are building an AI-first way of working. Our team uses Claude every day, connected to WhizHQ (our proprietary internal software), HubSpot and our other tools, to pull client context, draft weekly updates, prepare reports and create content. We are looking for someone who:

* Already uses Claude, ChatGPT or a similar AI tool in their daily work, not just occasionally
* Writes clear instructions and reviews AI output with a critical eye
* Notices repetitive work and asks whether AI could do it better
* Wants to share workflows with the team and help us improve how we work

Bonus: experience with Claude Projects or connectors, custom GPTs, Zapier, or GoHighLevel automations.

**Tools you'll use**

Claude, Slack, ClickUp, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Zoom, Google Workspace, Canva, Eventbrite and WhizHQ, our proprietary internal software for client work such as blogs, newsletters, press releases, Google Business Profile posts,

jobs.description:
**Role Overview**

The Account Manager serves as the commercial and strategic relationship leader across a dedicated portfolio of approximately 50 existing public sector accounts. Operating in close partnership with dedicated Solutions Architects and delivery consultants, this individual is directly accountable for maximizing net revenue retention (NRR) through proactive contract renewals and targeted account expansion. Growth opportunities span the complete suite of Conducive's offerings: third-party software licensing and ingest tier upgrades, specialized professional consulting services, and long-term managed services contracts.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Account Governance & Portfolio Retention (~50 Accounts)**

* **Portfolio Ownership:** Own end-to-end commercial retention and health across ~50 public sector accounts, proactively tracking contract expiration dates, funding windows, and fiscal year-end deadlines.
* **Executive Business Reviews:** Lead structured quarterly business reviews (QBRs) to assess system utilization, platform health, SLA metrics, and future architecture roadmaps.
* **Proactive Health Monitoring:** Collaborate closely with delivery consultants and engineering teams to identify and remediate operational or adoption blockers well ahead of renewal cycles.

**2. Multi-Stream Growth & Quota Execution**

* **Software & Licensing Expansion:** Identify and close capacity ingest upgrades, additional workload licensing, and module additions across Splunk and associated observability/SIEM ecosystems.
* **Professional Consulting Services:** Scope and position technical consulting packages, cloud migrations, architecture modernizations, and bespoke implementation projects.
* **Managed Services Engagements:** Pitch and secure multi-year managed operations, continuous administration, monitoring support, and staff augmentation agreements.
* **Commercial Deal Leadership:** Shepherd opportunities from identification through technical scoping, proposal and statement-of-work (SOW) drafting, commercial negotiations, and contract closure.

**3. Technical & Pre-Sales Collaboration**

* **Solutions Architecture Alignment:** Partner with dedicated Solutions Architects and Sales Engineers to conduct technical discovery, architectural reviews, and solution demonstrations.
* **Value Translation:** Translate complex agency compliance mandates, logging bottlenecks, and security directives into clear, actionable technical workstreams.

**4. Public Sector Procurement & Operational Diligence**

* **Procurement Navigation:** Navigate government purchasing channels, state term contracts, piggyback mechanisms, GSA schedules, and sole-source justification requirements.
* **CRM Hygiene & Forecasting:** Maintain rigorous, audit-ready CRM documentation—tracking renewal pipelines, probability stages, contract values, and delivering highly dependable monthly and quarterly revenue forecasts.

**Role Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university.
* **Domain Experience:** Minimum of 5 years of professional experience directly within enterprise logging, SIEM, or observability domains (e.g., Splunk, Elastic, Datadog, Microsoft Sentinel).
* **Account Management Track Record:** Demonstrated success in a dedicated Account Management or Commercial Customer Success role with dual quota accountability for renewals and net-new expansions.
* **Public Sector Acumen:** Direct experience managing relationships and contracts within state, local, higher education (SLED), or federal government accounts, including understanding of fiscal budget cycles.
* **Technical Literacy:** Solid foundational understanding of SIEM/logging architectures, data onboarding, ingestion volume sizing, and compliance frameworks to independently lead initial qualification conversations.
* **Exceptional Detail Orientation:** High standard of organizational diligence, contract tracking rigor, and disciplined pipeline governance.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Splunk Certifications:** Splunk Core Certified Power User, Advanced Power User, or equivalent platform credentials.
* **Blended Solution Selling:** Proven background structuring blended deals combining software licenses, advisory consulting SOWs, and recurring managed services.
* **Contract Vehicles:** Working knowledge of major public sector contract vehicles (e.g., NASPO ValuePoint, GSA Schedule 70/MAS, OMNIA, state-wide master contracts).

**The Opportunity**  
The Product Business Operations role is part of the Products team and is responsible for the day-to-day commercial operations of NTS's software business. This person owns the processes that carry a customer from final deal coordination through license fulfillment, ongoing engagement, and renewal.  
Working with sales representatives, Customer Success, Product, Contracts, and Finance, the role keeps customer records accurate, transactions moving, forecasts current, and follow-up actions complete. Sales representatives retain responsibility for outside sales, new-business prospecting, account strategy, and commercial negotiations.

  

**Key Responsibilities** (Principal Duties and Accountabilities \*Essential Functions)

  

Deal Completion and Post Award Coordination

* Support representatives in completing quotes, approvals, order forms, purchase orders, and customer documentation needed to close and process software deals.
* Validate products, quantities, pricing, license terms, support coverage, and delivery requirements against approved orders; resolve discrepancies with Sales, Contracts, and Finance.
* Own the post-award handoff and action tracker through fulfillment, customer receipt, and billing readiness; escalate delays and missing information.

License Fulfillment and Entitlement Management

* Coordinate license issuance, delivery, activation instructions, and receipt confirmation; route technical activation or deployment issues to the appropriate team.
* Maintain accurate records of licensed products, quantities, customer entities, license terms, expiration dates, and maintenance or support entitlements.
* Process approved renewals, expansions, transfers, and license changes; track trial and evaluation expirations with the account representative.

CRM and Forecast Management

* Own CRM data quality across accounts, subaccounts, contacts, opportunities, orders, and renewals; reconcile records with license and transaction information.
* Run a regular forecast review with representatives to validate opportunity values, stages, close dates, procurement status, next steps, and accountable owners.
* Scrub stale opportunities, duplicate records, missing fields, and unsupported close dates; obtain representative updates and flag changes or risks for leadership.

Customer Outreach and Sales Coordination

* Conduct welcome, fulfillment, administrative, and follow-up outreach; maintain current end-user, purchasing, and reseller contacts and track requests to completion.
* Work with representatives to prioritize accounts needing outreach, quote follow-up, procurement assistance, or re-engagement; agree on owners and next actions.
* Coordinate onboarding and customer communications with Customer Success; surface adoption concerns, customer feedback, and expansion opportunities to the appropriate owner.

Renewals and Retention

* Own the renewal calendar and begin outreach early enough to accommodate customer budgeting and procurement timelines; keep representatives informed of upcoming expirations.
* Drive renewal quotes, reminders, approvals, purchase documentation, and fulfillment through completion; coordinate pricing or scope changes with the account representative.
* Identify potential lapses, reductions, or nonrenewals; coordinate recovery actions and record renewal outcomes and reasons for lost or reduced business.

Software Business Operations and Reporting

* Provide fulfillment records for invoicing and work with Finance and representatives to resolve order, billing, and payment-status issues.
* Maintain actionable reports on bookings, recurring revenue, renewals, fulfillment, forecast changes, and outstanding customer actions using definitions and records agreed with Finance.
* Maintain approved product and SKU information, templates, and operating procedures; improve handoffs and routine workflows to reduce errors and manual effort.

  

**Supervisory Responsibilities**  
Individual contributor with no direct reports. Manages business processes and coordinates work across teams; operates within established pricing, contracting, and financial approval policies.

* Strong written and spoken English; professional customer communication; ability to handle sensitive customer and commercial information with discretion.
* Ability to obtain a U.S. security clearance up to the Secret level.

  

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Information Systems, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.

  

**Required Skills, Experience & Abilities**

* Minimum 4 years of experience in software business operations, sales operations, revenue operations, renewals, customer operations, or a related role.
* Hands-on CRM experience, including account and opportunity maintenance, data cleanup, reporting, and forecast coordination.
* Experience with software orders, licensing, subscriptions or maintenance renewals, and customer fulfillment processes.
* Strong spreadsheet skills and ability to reconcile customer, order, license, and forecast data accurately.
* Ability to manage competing deadlines, follow up persistently, resolve operational issues, and drive actions to completion across teams.
* Sound judgment, attention to detail, and ability to communicate clearly with customers, representatives, and business leaders.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting government or defense customers, contract awards, purchase orders, resellers, and extended procurement cycles.
* Familiarity with both subscription and perpetual software licensing, support renewals, retention reporting, and recurring revenue metrics.
* Experience improving CRM workflows, documenting operating procedures, or automating routine business tasks.

**About YouScience, LLC**

YouScience® is the leading education technology company dedicated to empowering individuals with the data and credentials needed to succeed in school, career, and life.

Its award-winning platform, YouScience Brightpath®, is the only College & Career Readiness solution built for both compliance and impact—powered by scientifically backed aptitude discovery, industry-recognized certifications, and meaningful career connections.

YouScience has served more than 13,400 educational institutions and millions of users nationwide, making it the preferred choice for individuals, parents, educators, and counselors to achieve real outcomes through education and career pathways.

**Job Description**

The Manager of Sales Enablement will be responsible for equipping our revenue teams with the knowledge, content, and tools required to drive growth and improve sales productivity in the education technology sector. You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to build, deliver, and continuously optimize onboarding programs, ongoing training, and sales enablement resources. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, combining a strong understanding of B2B/EdTech sales cycles with expertise in instructional design and revenue technology platforms. By bridging product knowledge, market insights, and sales execution, you will play a critical role in helping sales representatives achieve consistent quota performance and accelerate time-to-value for customers. Successful candidates will bring a proactive, data-driven approach to identifying skill gaps, measuring training impact, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and high performance.

This role has the flexibility to be remote, in office (American Fork, Utah), or hybrid.

### **Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and manage comprehensive onboarding programs for new sales representatives to accelerate time to productivity.
* Develop and maintain a centralized repository of sales collateral, playbooks, battle cards, and pitch decks in collaboration with Product Marketing.
* Partner with sales leadership to identify skill and knowledge gaps across account executives and territory managers, creating targeted training initiatives.
* Administer and optimize sales technology tools, learning management systems (LMS), and revenue enablement platforms to support day-to-day sales operations.
* Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate the effectiveness of enablement programs and report metrics to executive stakeholders.
* Facilitate ongoing continuous education, including product releases, competitive positioning, consultative selling methodologies, and industry trends.
* Conduct regular ride-alongs and call reviews (e.g., via Gong) to coach representatives on discovery, handling objections, and closing strategies.
* Collaborate with Product and Marketing teams to translate complex software features into compelling, value-based customer messaging.
* Organize and execute sales enablement events, quarterly sales training workshops, and annual sales kick-off (SKO) programming.

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Education, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 3-5+ years of experience in Sales Enablement, Sales Training, Product Marketing, or B2B SaaS Sales Excellence roles.
* Proven track record of designing, building, and delivering successful onboarding and continuous training programs for sales teams.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales enablement/LMS technologies (e.g., Docebo, LearnUpon, Gong, Highspot).
* Exceptional presentation, facilitation, and communication skills with the ability to engage diverse audiences and senior executives.
* Strong understanding of consultative selling methodologies and B2B SaaS buyer journeys.

### **Extra Credit**

* Direct experience working within the Education Technology (EdTech) or K-12 / Higher Education market sectors.
* Prior individual contributor experience in quota-carrying B2B software sales or account management.
* Familiarity with career and technical education (CTE), aptitude assessments, or industry-recognized certifications.
* Formal certifications in sales methodologies (e.g., Challenger, MEDDPICC, Solution Selling) or Instructional Design.

**Become a part of our caring community**
=========================================

The Data & AI Enablement Lead is a strategic individual contributor who partners with Finance, IT, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex business needs and data into actionable analytics and AI-enabled solutions. The role will shape Data & AI strategy and adoption; where the Data & AI Enablement Lead will lead and/or facilitate the following activities: evaluate and advance high-value use cases, facilitate delivery from discovery through adoption, communicate recommendations to diverse audiences, and promote responsible AI through effective governance, risk management, monitoring, and compliance.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Data & AI strategy and roadmap:** Partner with business and technology leaders to define AI priorities, identify capability gaps, develop roadmaps, and align investments with measurable business outcomes.
* **Use-case identification and facilitation:** Lead workshops and intake discussions to identify, assess, prioritize, and shape AI and advanced analytics opportunities based on value, feasibility, data readiness, risk, and scalability.
* **Data & AI governance and responsible use:** Help establish and operationalize AI governance standards, decision rights, review processes, documentation requirements, and controls throughout the AI lifecycle.
* **Risk assessment and oversight:** Coordinate with Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Security, Data Governance, and other stakeholders to evaluate model risk, bias, explainability, data quality, privacy, security, and regulatory considerations.
* **Solution development and delivery:** Provide technical leadership for the design, testing, validation, implementation, and monitoring of machine learning, generative AI, and other AI-enabled solutions.
* **Business and technical support:** Advise teams on appropriate AI methods, tools, platforms, data requirements, prompt design, model selection, testing approaches, and implementation options.
* **Performance monitoring:** Define success measures and support ongoing monitoring of solution accuracy, reliability, adoption, risk, and business impact; recommend remediation or retirement when appropriate.
* **AI adoption and enablement:** Develop guidance, reusable assets, training, and communications that improve AI literacy and promote consistent, secure, and responsible adoption across the organization.
* **Stakeholder communication:** Translate complex AI concepts, risks, and findings into clear recommendations for business leaders, governance forums, and technical teams.
* **Continuous improvement:** Stay current on emerging AI capabilities, industry practices, and evolving standards, and recommend practical improvements to the organization’s AI operating model.

**Use your skills to make an impact**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of analytics experience or Master's degree and 3+ years of analytics experience.
* Demonstrated ability to serve as a consultative analytics partner, working directly with business stakeholders to define problems, evaluate opportunities, and deliver actionable recommendations.
* Experience leading projects through the full analytics/AI lifecycle, including business intake, discovery, analysis, solution development, communication of insights, and implementation support.
* Experience using SQL, Power BI, Databricks, Python, or similar tools to support business decision-making.

* Advanced degree in Informatics, Analytics, Business Analytics, Healthcare Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science or a related field.

new_jobs.description:
**Mission Graduates** is a nonprofit organization that increases the number of K-12 students in San Francisco's Mission District who are prepared for and complete a college education. We work towards fulfilling our mission through a wide range of afterschool support services that serve over 4,800 children, youth, and families each year. Our vision is to transform the culture of our neighborhood so that college becomes the expectation for Mission families, rather than the exception.

**Program Summary:** Mission Graduates has been providing quality afterschool programming for its entire 50-year history. The organization is partnering with June Jordan School of Equity (JJSE) to develop and implement a quality afterschool program that blends extracurricular activities and builds a college-going culture on campus. Youth who participate in the program develop a sense of self-confidence in their ability to learn, to speak their voice, and contribute to their community. The program infuses college messaging throughout its curriculum to ensure both youth and parents develop or strengthen expectations for entering college.

  

**Key Responsibilities & Primary Duties**

### **Program Management & Evaluation (25%)**

Assist in the maintenance of all program records, particularly maintenance of attendance.  
Assist the Director in developing and managing the annual program budget.  
Maintain knowledge of ExCEL policies and procedures.  
Assist in program evaluation and the utilization of evaluation findings in program development to ensure positive outcomes.  
Assist in the preparation of funding proposals and reports to funders.

### **Program Quality, Support, & Delivery (50%)**

* Work with program staff to deliver quality afterschool programming, including supervision of at least three clubs or programs.

  + Lead the JJSE leadership student group, meeting weekly. Create meeting agendas, lead activities, and support students in running school-wide events.
  + Manage the academic tutoring program and referral process.
* Uphold all school-site policies for safety, supervision, mandated reporting, and risk management.

* Assist in the preparation of internal marketing materials to be disseminated to students, parents, and the JJSE community.
* Collaborate closely with community stakeholders including parents and caregivers, community-based organizations, and SFUSD.
* Assist the JJSE Director in developing parent engagement activities and maintaining positive parent relations with current JJSE families.
* Assist and lead summer programming in academics, enrichment, and/or recreation.

* In collaboration with other MG team members, oversee recruitment, training, and supervision of volunteers and program consultants.
* Assist/Support the SFUSD teachers and staff who are given stipends to implement Extended Day clubs and activities.

* Engaging with families to facilitate two-way communication and information sharing, highlighting school and program activities at JJSE.

new_jobs.title: Clinical Case Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job Description:

**Clinical Case Manager**

**Transitional Age Youth Full Service Partnership (TAY FSP)**

**Adult Division**

**Agency Overview**

Felton Institute responds to the needs of our community by providing innovative, evidence-informed social services that transform lives. Our organization offers 60+ programs that address mental health, the unhoused, early care and education, those impacted by the justice system, transitional age youth, as well as aging adults. Our programs combine the latest scientific research with cultural sensitivity and a deep commitment to supporting and reflecting the communities we serve. Felton offers a dynamic, challenging, and supportive work environment where we encourage the use of professional development, that staff can utilize throughout their career.

**Program Description**

Serving young adults living with serious mental illness, the TAY FSP program provides an extensive array of recovery-oriented, age-appropriate services and supports, including linkage to housing, basic needs, physical health care, benefits assistance, and employment services, and integrated mental health and substance abuse treatment services. The program follows an assertive community treatment model, providing medication management, individual and group therapy, individual and group rehabilitation, crisis intervention, and case management both in the office and in the community. The program consists of a multi-disciplinary team of a psychiatrist(s), nurse practitioner(s), registered nurse(s), a program director, clinical case managers, case managers, a client support specialist, and an administrative manager. Clinicians are expected to provide services to clients both in the office and in the field.

**Job Description**

The Clinical Case Manager (CCM) meets with and evaluates the needs of clients and develops a treatment plan in collaboration with the client. The Clinical Case Manager provides specialized mental health services, including therapy, rehabilitative skills training, crisis intervention, and case management. The Clinical Case Manager provides a safe and supportive environment for the client and their support system and adheres to laws regarding confidentiality and mandated reporting. Services are provided both in the field (hospital, client’s home, courthouse, doctor’s office, etc.) and in the office. The Clinical Case Manager must maintain accurate detailed records in our electronic health record system. The caseload for each CCM is at least 17 clients.

**Specific Responsibilities**

* Provide individual and group therapy, individual and group rehabilitative skills training, case management, and crisis intervention services to our clients.
* Link clients to basic needs, including income, housing, job training, insurance, and/or nutrition, among other resources.
* Assist clients in creating and maintaining stability in the community by offering at least weekly appointments.
* Collaborate with community partners in housing, finance, basic needs, and medical services.
* Provide independent living skills education to clients in the office and in their home.
* Responsible for an average of 60-66 hours of direct services per month.
* Maintain timely documentation of services provided that meet Medi-Cal standards.
* Provide officer-of-the-day responsibilities to TAY and Adult Mental Health Program clients.
* Maintains responsibility for the 24/7 crisis response phone during assigned coverage periods (usually every other month for a 2-week period), ensuring accessibility, timely response, and appropriate follow-up to all incoming crisis calls via phone. In-person response to calls outside of work hours (9am-5pm) is not required.

**Minimum Requirements and Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Social Work, MFT, or related field of study required.
* Must be, or have the potential to be, registered with California BBS and have an active associates number.
* Experience providing mental health services and/or case management to those living with a severe mental illness and/or substance use preferred.
* Comprehensive knowledge of mental health and substance abuse counseling, assessment, and crisis intervention skills.
* Willingness to work from a strength-based, harm reduction, client-centered model with an emphasis on evidence-based practices.
* Ability to work cooperatively on a multi-disciplinary team, and to work with people of various ethnic and cultural backgrounds.
* Strong organizational, communication, documentation, time management, and interpersonal skills.

**Additional Information:**

Reports to: Program Director

Job Type: Full Time

Work Schedule: Onsite and in the community Mon-Fri 9am-5pm

FLSA Status: Exempt

Salary Range: $100,000 - $110,000 Annually (DOE)

Benefits (subject to election and eligibility): Fully-Paid Medical and Dental Plans; Health Reimbursement Card, Paid Time Off (personal, vacation, and sick time), 403B with company match.

*This position is union-represented by SEIU Local 1021 and is subject to the applicable collective bargaining agreement.*

**Applying Instruction:**

Candidates should apply for the position at our career page “careers.felton.org” OR directly email resumes to “jobs@felton.org”.

**IMP NOTE: Job responsibilities are subject to change according to program requirements.**

**Primary Purpose**  
  
The Operations Manager is responsible for enhancing the customer's shopping experience at a retail-oriented project by ensuring a clean, well maintained, and safe environment as well as asset preservation and enhancement. The Operations Manager will oversee operational functions, projects, construction, and contract / vendor services for Hillsdale Shopping Center.

**Principal Responsibilities**  
  
*The successful candidate's responsibilities will include, but not be limited to:*

* Oversee the daily operations of the shopping center including security, cleaning/ janitorial, landscaping, lighting, parking lot sweeping, etc. as needed to ensure compliance with service contracts and operational needs of the project.
* Manage relationships with third party contracted services providers. Interface with contractors and vendors.
* Create written specifications and secure bids for services in accordance with established bid process. Solicit bids, negotiate with vendors for goods and services, and hold vendors accountable for quality of work, billing accuracy and adherence to property policies & procedures.
* Research and evaluate best in class maintenance products and procedures.
* Conduct daily walk-throughs of the property to ensure physical assets are in best possible operating condition. Respond timely to any operational issues uncovered in property inspections and take action with appropriate vendor to correct issue as soon as possible.
* Lead and manage the CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) or work order system, coordinating with Local 39 engineering team to ensure work orders are tracked, prioritized, and completed in a timely manner.
* Ensure property safety systems are up to code, maintained and inspected.
* Manage property operating expenses within or below budget. Effectively manage negative financial variances to overcome or minimize loss within the property operating budget.
* Develop and implement a 5-year capital plan to operate, maintain and enhance the asset / property.
* Develop and oversee a preventative maintenance program on property equipment and record keeping / related logs.
* Manage (or co-manage along with Development and Construction departments) the work process for capital projects, construction, and tenant build-outs. Serve as the “boots on the ground” for monitoring and overseeing daily construction activity, review build-outs are completed to specifications, create punch-list items, and gather required documentation prior to project close-out and/or payment.
* Read and interpret engineering drawings, schematic diagrams, and build-out plans.
* Be familiar with general construction, sub-contractors, and project management.
* Ensure certificates of insurance are requested / received from all vendors working on the property.
* Maintain a safe environment through identification and elimination of any safety hazards to staff, tenants, and customers. This includes the administration of all training and regulatory programs (OSHA, ADA, EPA etc.).
* Ensure public safety, shopping center security, insurance protocols and effective risk management. Work with security and local officials to plan and oversee a fire safety program and coordinate onsite annual trainings with fire and police departments.
* Complete timely review, processing and approval of vendor invoices, to ensure accurate services were provided prior to payment.
* General knowledge of leases and / or ability to review in order to determine responsibility of operational issues.
* Oversee property utilities and implement an energy / utility plan to minimize costs while maintaining a comfortable and safe shopping experience.
* Assist in preparation and oversee operational budgets and ensure all costs associated with property operations are managed. Report on variances.
* Provide operations support as necessary for special events, marketing events and holidays.
* Assist the General Manager in the creation and planning of the Emergency Management Plan. Ensure all personnel are trained and ready to respond as outlined in the Emergency Management Plan.
* Oversee operational responsibilities in a crisis situation, ensuring the safety and security of customers, tenants, guest and assets. Help oversee any insurance claim and process.
* Responds to tenant operational issues. Resolves escalated customer / tenant complaints related to operations and maintenance.
* Establish strong relationships with service providers and key civic roles (Code Officials, Fire Safety, Police, Fire, etc.).

**Minimum Qualifications**

  

* Minimum 5 years of prior Operations, Facilities or Property Management experience.
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience.
* Working knowledge of property maintenance and operational functions.
* Working knowledge and past experience leading and managing a CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) at an asset to create and manage all work orders at a property. Experience with Cove a plus.
* Ability to read and understand blueprints, CAD drawings and other schematics.
* Ability to remain standing/walking 75% of the time.
* Customer service focused.
* Ability to be on call for emergencies.
* Self-motivated, team player with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Intermediate to advanced computer skills (email, excel, word, online systems, etc.).
* Valid driver's license.
* Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds.

**JOB OVERVIEW:**

The Operations Manager (OM) is responsible for the direct or indirect oversight and coordination of all operational functions in the Bay Area (San Jose and Oakland) grouping, resulting in a well-functioning, compliant operational environment. The Operations Manager serves as the primary liaison for HQ Regional Functional Leads including Supply Chain Advisor (SCA), Regional Safety & Security Director (RSSD), Regional IT Director (RITD) and Global Facilities Director (GFD). This position reports to the Executive Director and oversees the Operations staff in both offices. This position is based in either San Jose or Oakland, with regular weekly onsite presence within both offices.

**Major Responsibilities:**

**Safety & Security—S&S:**

* Oversee regional S&S matters.
* Responsible for the implementation and maintenance of all office S&S documentation.

* Report all S&S incidents involving covered persons in accordance with established protocols.

**Supply Chain—SC:**

* Serve as the region’s primary focal point for procurement, asset and inventory management, in-kind donations tracking and reporting, vehicle fleet management and transportation, and warehousing in accordance with established organizational and donor requirements.

* Support smooth functioning of office infrastructure including communications equipment and services.
* Assist with planning and coordinating office events and meetings.

**Information Technology—IT:**

* Demonstrated ability to work with deadlines and lead multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

new_jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
### **About the role**

Databricks bills customers on usage. Every month, millions of usage records turn into commit drawdowns, invoices and revenue. The Revenue Operations team within Order to Cash organization makes sure that happens accurately and on time.

We're hiring a **Revenue Operations Manager** to oversee usage operations and improve how contracts move from booking to invoicing. A key focus is Universal Commitment, our cloud-agnostic commit model. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Revenue Operations, you'll lead key month-end close activities for our billing and rating platform, oversee a team based in India, and drive process and automation improvements across Revenue Operations.

You'll work closely with the **Order to Revenue Process Compliance** team. That team sets usage policy, leads root-cause analysis and owns governance. Your team carries out the work: applying adjustments, keeping usage and billing in balance, and making sure each correction is documented, reviewed and fully reflected in our systems.

### **What you'll do**

#### **Revenue operations and contract setup**

* Own the booking review process. Validate orders in the booking queue and serve as the escalation point for upstream teams on complex contract structures.
* Make sure contract and usage settings are correct across our billing and rating platform, ERP and CPQ, so that Universal Commitment and other contract type invoice as intended.
* Advise Deal Desk and Revenue Assurance on whether non-standard terms can be billed (e.g., GPU reservations, per-hour pricing, custom SKUs) before deals close. Provide guidance on new product offerings and ensure operational feasibility prior to finance sign off.
* Define and report Revenue Operations KPIs, such as adjustment volume, close timeliness, and billing accuracy.

#### **Usage operations and adjustments**

* Oversee and approve usage adjustments, billing corrections and customer credits in DBAR and the ERP. This covers billing errors, SLA credits and customer satisfaction (CSAT) credits, in line with Usage Compliance policies and approval levels.
* Serve as the escalation point for manual usage processing, including manual usage uploads, reservation and non-standard billing, ledger entries, and retract-and-restate corrections, with a full audit trail.
* Make sure usage-to-contract mapping, including customer workspace moves, PAYG-to-commit conversions and mid-term contract changes, with the correct effective dates.
* Act as the Revenue Operations owner of the refund and credit process, from intake, and validation through execution.
* Approve or deny account provisioning requests (suspend, unsuspend, grace-period extensions) with the Network Operations Center (NOC).
* Oversee usage tracking for customers with special provisions and non-standard language in their order form.

#### **Month-end and quarter-end close**

* Lead our contract reconciliation which ingests and compares usage across all clouds at the contractual level. Partner with Engineering, from pre-close through delivery of the final usage file to Revenue Accounting .
* Run usage categorization and commit and PAYG reconciliations, between the billing platform and the ERP across all clouds.
* Own billing finalization (Billing Mass Finalization / ledger freeze), the step that closes each month.
* Partner with the Revenue Accounting on usage flux analysis and contribute to shorten the close timeline.
* Act as preparer and/or reviewer for assigned SOX controls (e.g., usage reconciliation and SKU pricing accuracy) and keep audit evidence ready.Align with RevOps team to continue to improve recon process by assimilating processes across all clouds. Oversee Universal Commit contract reconciliation to ensure completeness.

#### **Team leadership and scale**

* Lead and develop the GBS usage team (India). Set priorities, review work, and steadily expand team ownership.Write, maintain and centrally store SOPs for every recurring process, and make sure each critical close task has a trained backup.
* Use SQL and Databricks dashboards to automate reconciliations and reduce manual effort, working toward touchless billing.

#### **Cross-functional partnership**

* Partner with the Usage Compliance team. Hand off recurring adjustment patterns and supporting data for root-cause analysis, put new policies into practice, and report adjustment volume and status.
* Work with the Money/DBAR Engineering, IT/Business Systems, Deal Desk, Billing, Collections and Revenue Accounting teams to resolve usage and billing issues quickly.
* Serve as subject matter expert on strategic initiatives and projects by working with our commercialization team, engineering, and other GTM and Accounting teams. Will require driving project initiatives in certain cases.

### **What we're looking for**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business or a related field.
* 6+ years in revenue operations, billing operations or order-to-cash, ideally with usage- or consumption-based billing.
* 2+ years managing people, including leading offshore or shared-service teams.
* Hands-on experience with billing or rating systems and a major ERP (e.g., SAP, NetSuite or Oracle), plus Salesforce/CPQ.
* Strong SQL skills. Experience with Databricks is a plus.
* Track record of running month-end close tasks on time, with SOX controls.
* Experience leading or guiding offshore or shared-services teams.
* Clear written communication and a habit of documenting your work and sharing knowledge openly.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with commit, drawdown and burst contract models, or cloud marketplace billing (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Working knowledge of usage-based revenue recognition (ASC 606).
* Experience with system migrations or parallel runs for billing or ERP platforms.

new_jobs.title: Patient Advocate I
new_jobs.description:
**About Henry Meds:**  
Henry Meds is a direct-to-consumer telehealth company on a mission to create a world where everyone has the health to live fully– regardless of insurance status or plan. As a telehealth organization delivering virtual health care to patients in 40 states and DC through a professional corporation–management services organization ("PC-MSO") model, clinical care is delivered by physician-owned professional entities, and Henry Meds provides administrative, technology, and business support services under management services agreements.

We're headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, with a largely remote U.S. team. We work under a guiding principle that puts patients first, driven by five values: Integrity Always, Own It, Be Relentless, Stay Curious, and Win Together. We are driven to fulfil our mission and create a great place to work.

Enjoy the casual culture, remote-first workplace, and generous PTO/benefits!

Apply today to make a direct, daily impact in one of the fastest-growing startups in the country - we are excited to meet you!

  

**Position Overview:**

The Patient Advocate I is a primary frontline contact for Henry Meds patients. This role resolves standard non-clinical needs through phone, voicemail, email, chat, and other approved channels. The Patient Advocate I owns the patient interaction, completes authorized actions, coordinates internal help when needed, and keeps the patient informed through resolution.

  

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

#### **Patient Support**

* Communicate with patients by phone, email, and chat using timely, empathetic, and ownership-driven service.
* Work as a generalist across phone, email, chat, voicemail, billing, account support, subscriptions, scheduling, refill support, portal navigation, order support, and other approved non-clinical workflows.
* Accept channel and work-type assignments based on patient needs, volume, staffing, and operational priorities rather than individual preference.
* Resolve standard questions involving accounts, subscriptions, billing, scheduling, refill processes, portal use, intake forms, and order status.
* Guide new and existing patients through Henry systems and established care processes.
* Troubleshoot basic platform and account-access issues.
* Use approved retention and service-recovery options when appropriate.

#### **Case Ownership and Coordination**

* Own assigned patient needs from first contact through documented resolution.
* Complete authorized actions in the CRM, EHR, billing platform, and related systems.
* Manage the non-clinical portion of requests that also require clinical action.
* Explain next steps, expected timing, and any action required from the patient.
* Escalate stalled or unresolved work through the defined operating path.

#### **Clinical Boundaries and Compliance**

* Recognize possible symptoms, side effects, medication questions, and other clinical content.
* Route clinical matters to Patient Safety or the appropriate licensed team without providing clinical advice.
* Protect patient confidentiality and follow HIPAA, privacy, security, and documentation requirements.

#### **Quality and Improvement**

* Follow approved daily work assignments, queue priorities, coverage direction, and workflow guidance issued by the Manager or a designated Patient Advocate Leader.
* Meet established quality, accuracy, productivity, timeliness, attendance, and schedule expectations.
* Stay current on approved process, policy, product, pricing, and system changes.
* Identify unclear procedures, broken workflows, and recurring causes of repeat patient contact.

  

**You will likely have:**

* Experience in telehealth, healthcare, pharmacy support, subscription services, or regulated customer service.
* Experience with Zendesk, Zoho, an EHR, or billing platforms.

  

**You may have:**

* Previous experience in customer service, healthcare support, care coordination, a call center, or another high-volume service environment.
* Clear and compassionate verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong active listening, problem-solving, organization, and follow-through.
* Comfort learning and working across CRM, EHR, billing, and communication systems.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating with a distributed team.
* Ability to maintain clinical boundaries and follow escalation requirements.
* Commitment to patient privacy, accurate documentation, and continuous learning.

**Company Offers:**

* Platinum PPO Healthcare + Vision & Dental (Henry covers 99% for employees and 50% for their qualified dependents).
* 401(k) with matching contributions beginning your first day.
* Unlimited PTO (target of 4 weeks), 6 floating holidays, and 4 company observed holidays.
* Fully remote position with occasional travel.
* Impactful, rewarding work as part of a fast-growing brand helping thousands of people every day.

  

**Equal Opportunity Statement:**

Henry Meds is committed to promoting an inclusive work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We value a diverse and balanced team where everyone can belong.

  

**Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We cannot sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.**

**Salary Range**: $23.00 - $25.00

*This salary represents Henry Med's good faith and reasonable estimate of the possible compensation for this role at the time of posting, and Henry Meds may ultimately pay more or less than the posted salary. The final salary for this position will be determined by Henry Meds sole discretion, consistent with applicable law, and based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the employee's work experience, skills, and qualifications for the role, as well as the needs of Henry Meds business and other operational considerations.*
