**Marketing Account Manager**

Full-time W-2 employee · Remote, United States (excluding California) · Monday to Friday

Medical Marketing Whiz is hiring a full-time Marketing Account Manager to own the relationship with a portfolio of medical spa, aesthetics, women's health, functional medicine and weight loss practices. You will be the person our clients know by name: you set the plan, keep every project moving, and make sure each client always knows what we are working on and what comes next.

This is a full-time W-2 position, not a contract or a side project. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. We are not able to consider applicants who live in California.

**About Medical Marketing Whiz**

Medical Marketing Whiz delivers marketing strategy and execution for aesthetics and medical spas, women's health practices, functional medicine providers and weight loss clinics, including marketing programs offered through leading aesthetic device manufacturers. In 2026 we joined AscendPoint Agency, which gives our team and our clients more resources than ever.

We are known for creative campaigns, consistent execution and measurable growth. We are also moving fast toward an AI-first way of working, and we want teammates who are excited to help shape it.

**You won't be doing this alone**

You are your clients' main point of contact, but you are never the only person doing the work. Behind every account you manage is a team that handles the specialized pieces:

* **Website team:** builds, edits, hosting and maintenance
* **SEO team:** blogs, local SEO, Google Business Profile and directory listings
* **Paid ads specialist:** Meta and Google ad campaigns
* **Design and social media support:** graphics and recurring social content
* **Campaign and automation builder:** landing pages, funnels, review requests and event campaigns in GoHighLevel
* **Experienced account managers** who share what's working with their clients in our team channel every day
* **Leadership** that joins difficult client conversations, escalations and renewal or cancellation calls
* **WhizHQ**, our proprietary internal software, which connects directly to Claude, so less of your day goes to busywork

New account managers get a structured onboarding, a handoff brief for every client they take over, a weekly team meeting and regular trainings.

**What you'll do**

* Serve as the primary marketing contact for 20 or more client accounts
* Lead regular strategy calls with doctors and practice owners: review results, present ideas and recommend next steps
* Send every client a proactive update each week covering what's done, what's in progress, what's next and anything we need from them
* Plan and deliver campaigns, including email newsletters, SMS, social media, in-office and virtual events, webinars, press releases, landing pages, funnels, lead magnets and seasonal promotions
* Hand requests to the website, SEO, ads and design teams, track them in ClickUp and follow through until they are delivered
* Coach clients on following up with leads from Meta and Google ads, and on growing their email lists and reviews
* Review performance data and reports and recommend adjustments that improve results
* Keep a complete record of every client relationship in HubSpot, Slack and the client's shared folder
* Spot risk early and bring stalled projects, unhappy clients and cancellation requests to leadership right away
* Use AI every day, and help us find and build the next workflow worth improving

**How we work**

These are the habits that matter most on our team:

* **Clients never have to ask what's happening.** Every client knows who their contact is, what's in progress, what's next and when the next call is. A short check-in counts, even when there's no big news.
* **If it isn't logged, it didn't happen.** Call notes, emails and decisions go in HubSpot. Client conversations happen in that client's Slack channel, not in direct messages. A complete record protects the client, you and the company.
* **Requests go through the system.** Website edits and team requests go through ClickUp, so nothing gets lost.
* **Tell the truth and coach.** Be honest with clients about results, good or bad. When something isn't working, say so and bring a clear next step. When a client gets frustrated by things that don't move the needle, help them refocus on what grows their practice.
* **Escalate early.** If a project stalls or a client is unhappy, tell leadership before it becomes a problem. When a client mentions canceling, leadership joins the conversation right away.
* **Healthcare marketing has rules.** Press releases go out under the clinic's name. Review requests never ask patients to name a staff member. Some states restrict referral rewards. Patient privacy applies to everything we touch.
* **AI drafts, people approve.** We use AI heavily, and a person checks every word and image before a client sees it. We never use AI-generated images of a client's office, devices, providers or patients.

**Working with AI**

We are building an AI-first way of working. Our team uses Claude every day, connected to WhizHQ (our proprietary internal software), HubSpot and our other tools, to pull client context, draft weekly updates, prepare reports and create content. We are looking for someone who:

* Already uses Claude, ChatGPT or a similar AI tool in their daily work, not just occasionally
* Writes clear instructions and reviews AI output with a critical eye
* Notices repetitive work and asks whether AI could do it better
* Wants to share workflows with the team and help us improve how we work

Bonus: experience with Claude Projects or connectors, custom GPTs, Zapier, or GoHighLevel automations.

**Tools you'll use**

Claude, Slack, ClickUp, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Zoom, Google Workspace, Canva, Eventbrite and WhizHQ, our proprietary internal software for client work such as blogs, newsletters, press releases, Google Business Profile posts,

new_jobs.title: Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Role Overview**

The Account Manager serves as the commercial and strategic relationship leader across a dedicated portfolio of approximately 50 existing public sector accounts. Operating in close partnership with dedicated Solutions Architects and delivery consultants, this individual is directly accountable for maximizing net revenue retention (NRR) through proactive contract renewals and targeted account expansion. Growth opportunities span the complete suite of Conducive's offerings: third-party software licensing and ingest tier upgrades, specialized professional consulting services, and long-term managed services contracts.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Account Governance & Portfolio Retention (~50 Accounts)**

* **Portfolio Ownership:** Own end-to-end commercial retention and health across ~50 public sector accounts, proactively tracking contract expiration dates, funding windows, and fiscal year-end deadlines.
* **Executive Business Reviews:** Lead structured quarterly business reviews (QBRs) to assess system utilization, platform health, SLA metrics, and future architecture roadmaps.
* **Proactive Health Monitoring:** Collaborate closely with delivery consultants and engineering teams to identify and remediate operational or adoption blockers well ahead of renewal cycles.

**2. Multi-Stream Growth & Quota Execution**

* **Software & Licensing Expansion:** Identify and close capacity ingest upgrades, additional workload licensing, and module additions across Splunk and associated observability/SIEM ecosystems.
* **Professional Consulting Services:** Scope and position technical consulting packages, cloud migrations, architecture modernizations, and bespoke implementation projects.
* **Managed Services Engagements:** Pitch and secure multi-year managed operations, continuous administration, monitoring support, and staff augmentation agreements.
* **Commercial Deal Leadership:** Shepherd opportunities from identification through technical scoping, proposal and statement-of-work (SOW) drafting, commercial negotiations, and contract closure.

**3. Technical & Pre-Sales Collaboration**

* **Solutions Architecture Alignment:** Partner with dedicated Solutions Architects and Sales Engineers to conduct technical discovery, architectural reviews, and solution demonstrations.
* **Value Translation:** Translate complex agency compliance mandates, logging bottlenecks, and security directives into clear, actionable technical workstreams.

**4. Public Sector Procurement & Operational Diligence**

* **Procurement Navigation:** Navigate government purchasing channels, state term contracts, piggyback mechanisms, GSA schedules, and sole-source justification requirements.
* **CRM Hygiene & Forecasting:** Maintain rigorous, audit-ready CRM documentation—tracking renewal pipelines, probability stages, contract values, and delivering highly dependable monthly and quarterly revenue forecasts.

**Role Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university.
* **Domain Experience:** Minimum of 5 years of professional experience directly within enterprise logging, SIEM, or observability domains (e.g., Splunk, Elastic, Datadog, Microsoft Sentinel).
* **Account Management Track Record:** Demonstrated success in a dedicated Account Management or Commercial Customer Success role with dual quota accountability for renewals and net-new expansions.
* **Public Sector Acumen:** Direct experience managing relationships and contracts within state, local, higher education (SLED), or federal government accounts, including understanding of fiscal budget cycles.
* **Technical Literacy:** Solid foundational understanding of SIEM/logging architectures, data onboarding, ingestion volume sizing, and compliance frameworks to independently lead initial qualification conversations.
* **Exceptional Detail Orientation:** High standard of organizational diligence, contract tracking rigor, and disciplined pipeline governance.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Splunk Certifications:** Splunk Core Certified Power User, Advanced Power User, or equivalent platform credentials.
* **Blended Solution Selling:** Proven background structuring blended deals combining software licenses, advisory consulting SOWs, and recurring managed services.
* **Contract Vehicles:** Working knowledge of major public sector contract vehicles (e.g., NASPO ValuePoint, GSA Schedule 70/MAS, OMNIA, state-wide master contracts).
